Sparse holds whole-note roots; full and peak add an octave-leaping riff whose root slowly walks the progression while the filter breathes over 16-32 cycles.
bass.glitch.sub_dropout.01 | stem | glitch bass sub sine dropout mask 808 stutter low-end idm dub minimal heavy dark gated clicks-and-cuts ab-minor | - | A round Ab-minor sine sub whose groove is defined by what's missing: a per-cycle mask punches structural dropouts and nested half-drops into the pattern so the low end stutters and gaps like a glitching sampler. A four-cycle i-VII-v-III walk alternates the harmony and a slow lpf breathes over 16 cycles. Warm, heavy, and full of holes.
bass.glitch.sub_dropout.02 | stem | glitch bass sub fm growl dropout mask idm gated dark heavy restless low-end clicks-and-cuts dub-techno ab-minor | - | A grittier, FM-fed Ab-minor sub: a touch of FM adds a growl edge over the sine fundamental while a per-cycle mask punches structural dropouts and nested half-drops into the low end. A four-cycle walk alternates the harmony and a slow lpf breathes over 8-16 cycles. Where .01 is a clean gated sub, this one is a darker, growling glitch bass.
bass.gqom.drone_stab.01 | stem | gqom bass drone stab phrygian dark sub sawtooth menacing sa-club durban pump hypnotic low-end | - | Dark C phrygian drone bass: sparse holds whole-note drones cycling C-C-Bb-Db under a 32-cycle filter tide; full fires displaced stabs that mirror the gqom kick cells with the saw pump duck; peak adds octave-jump accents and a quiet octave-up off() ghost canon.
bass.house.deep_sub.01 | stem | house deep house bass sub sine pump sidechain octave deep warm night rolling hypnotic low end | - | Sine sub walking a i-i-VI-VII progression in G minor (G G Eb F), octave-jump 8ths under the isaw pump, filter blooming over 16 cycles. Peak switches to a 24db-filtered sawtooth with passing tones.
bass.house.deep_sub.02 | stem | house dub house deep house bass sub square syncopated dub dark moody spacious low end stab night | - | Darker dubby sibling: syncopated square-wave sub with rests and offbeat pickups, four-chord G-minor walk (G G/F Eb F) alternating per cycle, resonant 24db filter in the peak and lastOf doubling fills. Sparser and moodier than the .01 roller.
bass.idm.fm_rubber.01 | stem | idm braindance bass fm rubber rubbery elastic synth sub aphex autechre angular odd syncopated dark warm | - | Rubbery FM bass in D#/Eb minor: near-octave fmh(2.01) gives an elastic bounce with a fast bite envelope, a syncopated octave-jump cell with odd accents, and a 4-cycle i-i-VI-VII harmonic drift that keeps recontextualising the accents. Sidechain-feel saw pump, 8-32 cycle filter tide, octave-up phrase-end fill at peak.
bass.idm.fm_rubber.02 | stem | idm braindance bass fm metallic clangy sub deep dub aphex autechre dark menacing sustained warm | - | Deep metallic sibling in D#/Eb minor: inharmonic fmh(3.37) gives a clangy bell-metal sheen over a long-decaying sustained sub, walking a i-VII-VI-i drift with a rolling half-time feel. Heavier and darker than the .01 rubber skitter; sidechain-feel saw pump, octave-up phrase-end fill at peak.
bass.italo.arp16.01 | stem | bass italo hi-nrg disco arpeggio arp 16th sequencer pump driving euphoric 80s retro sawtooth minor | - | Relentless 16th-note root-octave arp bass walking a full F#m-D-A-E progression, thirds sneaking in on bar tails, isaw pump, reversed arp every 8th cycle and doubled-speed fill every 4th at peak.
bass.italo.arp16.02 | stem | bass italo hi-nrg arpeggio arp square chip up-down sequencer pump moody night 80s retro minor | - | Hollow square-wave arp that climbs root-fifth-octave-tenth and falls back, over a moodier i-v-VI-VII progression (F#m C#m D E); iter rotation in sparse, masked breath at bar 8, octave-up off-echo at peak.
bass.italo.octave_pump.01 | stem | italo hi-nrg disco bass octave pump sidechain euphoric driving night retro 80s synth sawtooth | - | Driving eighth-note octave bass with sidechain-feel isaw gain pump, 24db filter bloom, and galloping peak variant.
bass.italo.octave_pump.03 | stem | bass italo hi-nrg disco octave pump sidechain progression euphoric anthemic driving 80s retro sawtooth night | - | Octave-eighths italo bass that actually moves: a full I-vi-IV-V progression (A F#m D E) under the isaw pump, 24db filter breathing over 16 cycles, whole-cycle octave lift every 8th cycle.
bass.italo.octave_pump.04 | stem | bass italo hi-nrg gallop fm growl pump sidechain dark hard driving 80s synth night sub | - | Harder, darker gallop bass — eighth-plus-two-sixteenths hi-NRG rhythm on a growling near-unison FM sine, isaw pump, reversed fill every 8th cycle, and a chunked octave jump that walks through the bar at peak.
bass.jazz.walking_251.01 | stem | jazz walking-bass bass ii-v-i upright bebop swing dorian mixolydian classic combo acoustic warm supper-club | - | Harvested walking line rebuilt scale-per-chord: D dorian to G mixolydian to C major, quarter-note walk with skips, double-time fill bars, slow filter bloom.
bass.jazz.walking_251.02 | stem | jazz walking-bass bass minor ii-v-i two-feel upright noir dark ballad locrian phrygian moody smoky | - | Dark detuned-sine upright feel: minor ii-V-i (B locrian, E phrygian, A minor); full variant arranges a two-feel half into a four-to-the-bar walk.
bass.jazz.walking_54.01 | stem | jazz 5/4 five-four take-five walking-bass bass odd-meter cool-jazz brubeck eb-minor hip swinging west-coast classic | - | Five-beat walking vamp in Eb minor, Take Five feel: 3+2 long tones in sparse, five-quarter walk in full, eighth-note skips and double-time bar-ends at peak.
bass.jazz.walking_ballad.01 | stem | jazz ballad walking-bass bass slow upright romantic bb-major late-night warm torch-song supper-club classic tender | - | Slow Bb major ballad walk: half-note two-feel in sparse, quarter walk with chromatic approach tones in full, 8-bar turnaround with passing eighths at peak.
bass.jungle.fs_reese.01 | stem | reese bass jungle dnb drum-and-bass ragga rolling sawtooth detuned dark hypnotic 90s subby moving-filter | - | Rolling detuned-sawtooth reese with a slow filter bloom — the classic jungle/dnb moving bass, sourced from the full_show jungle improv.
bass.jungle.fs_reese.02 | stem | reese neuro bass dnb jungle dubstep wobble growl aggressive sawtooth resonant mechanical dark fifth-stack | - | Aggressive fifth-stacked reese with a fast filter wobble and a slow resonance swell — the darker, growlier child of the jungle reese.
bass.rave.hoover.01 | stem | hoover bass rave hardcore mentasm supersaw detune penv dark aggressive 1991 warehouse belgian techno | - | The '91 Belgian hoover: detuned supersaw with pitch-envelope dive, F minor stab riff, 32-cycle filter bloom, isaw pump, octave-up screams every 8 bars at peak.
bass.rave.hoover.02 | stem | hoover bass rave hardcore doom descending lament supersaw detune penv dark heavy menacing belgian | - | Doomier hoover flavor: F minor lament descent (f-eb-db-c) with huge pitch dives, ply re-trigger pump wall instead of a riff — slow-burn menace to the .01's stab machine.
bass.rave.reese.01 | stem | reese bass detune superimpose dark rave hardcore jungle dnb rolling menacing sub warehouse 1992 | - | C minor reese: sawtooth superimposed a few cents apart for that slow phase-beat growl, rolling hardcore pattern with isaw pump, ply-stuttered double-time fills at peak.
bass.rave.reese.02 | stem | reese bass vowel wobble talking detune superimpose polymeter dark rave hardcore jungle menacing 1992 | - | Talking reese: detune stack pushed through a cycling vowel filter for a wobbling mouth-bass character; elongated riff cells at full, 5-against-8 polymeter drift at peak.
bass.reggaeton.tumbao.01 | stem | bass tumbao reggaeton latin salsa anticipation syncopated offbeat sawtooth gminor warm driving montuno afrocuban groovy | - | Salsa tumbao bass in G minor: rests on the downbeat, hits the 'and of 2', then lands the beat-4 anticipation note that rings across the barline on a long release to voice the next chord early, over an i-VI-iv-V progression that turns each cycle. bass.reggaeton.tumbao.02 | stem | bass sub 808 tresillo reggaeton perreo dembow latin fm sine gminor dark club round modern | - | Modern perreo sub-bass: a round FM sine root gated into the 3+3+2 tresillo (hits on the 1, 4 and 7), the last held on a long release as an anticipation into the downbeat, walking an i-VI-iv-V root progression in G minor that turns each cycle. Dark and clubby with off-eighth octave pops; peak busier.
bass.techno.ebm_16.01 | stem | ebm techno industrial bass 16ths stabs body-music dark aggressive phrygian driving sequencer retro 80s | - | Anhalt EBM sequencer bass: relentless sawtooth 16ths hammering the phrygian root with b2 and b3 jabs, riff alternating between two bars, 24db filter breathing over 16 cycles, saw gain-pump accents, reversed-riff fill every 8th bar, octave leaps and stereo detune at peak.
bass.techno.rumble.01 | stem | techno bass sub rumble berlin warehouse dark deep sidechain pump hypnotic low-end | - | Berghain-style rumble: saturated sine sub living in the offbeats between kicks, i-i-VI-VII walk (c#-c#-a-b) advancing each cycle, room+shape doing the smear, saw gain-pump breathing against the four, ply fills at the 8-bar seam, octave-up ghost at peak.
bass.techno.rumble.02 | stem | techno dub-techno bass sub tresillo dub deep hypnotic echo rumble dark low-end swaying | - | Dub-techno flavor of the rumble: triangle sub on a rotating (3,8) tresillo with a c#-b-a-b minor walk, echo-sent octave ghost hits answering above, deeper room, dotted dub delay. bass.trance.rolling.01 | stem | trance uplifting bass rolling offbeat pump sidechain sawtooth driving euphoric club 138bpm night | - | Classic uplifting rolling bass: rest-on-the-kick 16th sawtooth triplets riding the isaw pump, an 8-cycle I-vi-IV-V progression in A major, 32-cycle 24db filter breathing, and a reversed turnaround every 8th cycle.
bass.trance.rolling.02 | stem | trance tech-trance bass square sub 16ths pump sidechain drive hypnotic dark relentless club | - | Tougher sibling: continuous 16th square-wave drive over a pure sine sub, both ducked by the isaw pump, I-V-vi-IV progression, cosine filter phase (opposite of the .01 sine), and an octave-lift on every 8th cycle. Peak breaks into an octave gallop.
bass.trap.808_glide.01 | stem | trap drill hip-hop 808 bass sub glide slide penv boomy dark heavy minor low-end club | - | Long-ringing sine 808 in C# minor with penv pitch glides sliding into every hit, a slowly breathing lpf, and a walking harmonic target note that alternates over four cycles.
bass.trap.808_glide.02 | stem | trap memphis phonk hip-hop 808 bass sub pulse glide distorted pump driving dark minor relentless | - | Rolling eighth-note distorted 808 pulse sibling: deeper penv slides, saw gain-pump duck under the kick, and a chunk-rotated octave accent that sweeps quarter by quarter through the bar.
bass.ukg.bounce.01 | stem | ukg uk garage speed garage bass organ bounce offbeat stab wavetable b minor bouncy club 97 bassline retro hooky | - | Offbeat electric-organ bass stabs (wavetable eorgan) bouncing through a B minor i-i-VI-VII progression, slow filter bloom, ply doubles every 8 bars, octave-echo canon at peak. bass.ukg.wobble_sub.01 | stem | ukg uk garage speed garage bass sub wobble lpf filter sawtooth warehouse heavy driving 2-step bassline dark pressure | - | Sawtooth sub through a sine-wobbled 24db lowpass, syncopated 2-step rhythm walking a G major I-I-vi-IV/V progression, octave-up fill every 8 bars, ply doubles at peak phrase ends. Warehouse pressure.
bass.ukg.wobble_sub.02 | stem | ukg uk garage dub dub garage bass sub wobble deep triangle warm spacious meditative 2-step bassline low end smoky | - | Round triangle sub, shaped hot for harmonics, slow-breathing lowpass wobble and dubby delay tails. Sparse skanking rhythm over a G-Em-D walk with silent-cycle breathing in sparse, walking octave lines at peak.
bass.vapor.smooth_walk.01 | stem | vaporwave vapor bass bassline walking-bass smooth jazz city-pop crooning warm synth-bass sawtooth mellow laid-back lo-fi retro 80s nostalgic dreamy romantic | - | A warm, dark sawtooth walking bass crooning a I-vi-ii-V turnaround in C major: skeletal roots that alternate footprint, a full four-to-the-bar walk with chord-tone approaches under a slow filter bloom and a gentle pump, and a peak that eighth-note walks with chromatic passing tones and lifts an octave every eighth cycle. City-pop smoke.
bass.vapor.smooth_walk.02 | stem | vaporwave vapor bass bassline sub sub-bass sine pillow deep doo-wop smooth slow moonlit minimal mellow lo-fi retro nostalgic dreamy melancholy | - | A deep sine sub-bass pillow crooning the 50s I-vi-IV-V doo-wop changes in C major: one long sustained root per bar under a slow filter breath, a dotted two-hit pump in the groove, and a peak that switches to a rounder sawtooth arpeggiated walk through root-fifth-third with an octave-down drop every eighth cycle. Softer, deeper and more melancholy than the croon walk.
bass.world.didgeridoo.01 | stem | didgeridoo yidaki drone bass aboriginal australian world organic buzzy overtone circular breathing earthy ritual sub tribal hypnotic primal | - | An E didgeridoo drone driven as a bass: struct-gated tonguing rhythms retrigger the e2 fundamental with a saw gain-pump for the circular-breathing swell, overblown toots alternate <e3 b3 e3> at phrase ends, a slow filter breath opens the buzz, and a lastOf(4) doubles the tongue rhythm. Peak fills the bar with a sixteen-slot tongue groove and iter rotation. add-note transposable off E.
bass.world.didgeridoo.02 | stem | didgeridoo yidaki drone bass aboriginal australian world ambient wobble overtone circular breathing meditative ritual sub ceremonial hypnotic spacious | - | A slower, ceremonial didgeridoo bass: a long sustained e2 drone with a wide slow filter wobble (yidaki breath), overblown vocal-call toots that alternate <b3 e4 g4> and answer through dub delay, opposite-phase pan drift, and a lastOf/iter evolution over long spans. More meditative and vocalized than the tongued sibling. add-note transposable off E.
chords.acid.stab_echo.01 | stem | acid stab chords rave echo delay square acid-house house techno 90s offbeat minor hoover-adjacent | - | Offbeat square-wave rave stabs in E minor walking a real i-VI-VII-v progression (Em C D Bm), soaked in dotted-8th delay. Counter-phase lpf/hpf sweeps keep the color moving; every 8th bar the stabs flip onto the downbeat.
chords.acid.stab_echo.02 | stem | acid dub stab chords ninth echo delay deep spacious dub-techno techno acid-house hypnotic euclid | - | Dubbier sibling: four-note ninth/seventh voicings (Em9 Cmaj7 Am7 Bm7) on a rotating euclid that slowly walks around the bar, saw timbre filtered dark, long delay feedback and big room. chords.amapiano.soul_keys.01 | stem | amapiano chords keys piano soulful gospel extended chords maj9 jazzy sparse yanos private school afro-house south african sa-house warm uplifting | - | Sparse, soulful extended piano chords in F major - Fmaj9 / Bbmaj9 / Gm9 / C9 - placed with lots of syncopated space the way amapiano keys breathe. chords.amapiano.soul_keys.02 | stem | amapiano chords keys piano gospel arpeggio rolling piano roll soulful flowing yanos private school afro-house south african sa-house uplifting melodic | - | The rolling amapiano piano - chords broken into flowing gospel arpeggios that cascade up and back through an Fmaj / Bb / Gm / C progression in F major. Sparse rolls a chord then leaves air; full is a continuous eight-note gospel run that reverses every eight cycles; peak doubles into sixteenth cascades with an octave shimmer. Contrasts the sparse-stab sibling with constant motion.
chords.cinematic.fs_impact.01 | stem | impact cluster chords cinematic epic drone finale huge sawtooth dramatic climax reverb orchestral dark | - | A huge detuned C-minor sawtooth cluster with cavernous reverb — re-triggering with a pump on the busier variants. chords.disco.stab_9ths.01 | stem | chords stabs 9ths disco offbeat sawtooth Bb-mixolydian funky salsoul philly dancefloor 70s progression pump | - | Harvested stage stab character rebuilt in Bb mixolydian: offbeat sawtooth 9th-chord stabs walking a descending Bb9-Abmaj9-Gm7-Fm9 progression via struct. chords.disco.stab_9ths.02 | stem | chords epiano rhodes comp 9ths rootless disco soul silky warm Bb-mixolydian mellow wavetable jazzy 70s | - | Sibling flavor: rootless 9th voicings comped on wavetable epiano — lazy Charleston-ish rhythm that alternates between two comp figures cycle by cycle, dub delay tail, slow filter bloom. chords.dnb.fs_parallelm7.01 | stem | chords minor7 parallel dnb liquid cinematic dark sawtooth moody melancholy descending stabs jazzy voicing | - | Descending Am7-Gm7-Fm7-Em7 parallel-motion sawtooth stabs with a slow filter sweep — the moody liquid/cinematic chord bed from the jungle section.
chords.dnb.fs_parallelm7.02 | stem | chords minor7 parallel dnb neuro techstep square resonant cold driving stabs pump dark voicing | - | The same descending minor7 progression driven as hard resonant square stabs with a sidechain-feel pump — a colder, techier flavor of the parallel-chord bed.
chords.dnb.liquid_keys.01 | stem | dnb drum and bass liquid liquid funk chords piano keys rhodes lush warm jazzy 9th bb major soulful smooth atmospheric night | - | Warm liquid drum & bass piano: lush maj9/min9 block chords walking Bbmaj9-Gm9-Ebmaj9-F9, one per bar, struct-driven and gently pumped, ringing into an orbit-4 delay. Motion instead of block stabs.

chords.dubtech.smoke.01 | stem | dub techno techno dub chords stabs offbeat skank minor7 a minor smoke smoky basic channel delay echo hypnotic deep cavernous night | - | Filtered offbeat minor-7 stabs — Am7/Dm7/Em7/Fmaj7 walking one chord per cycle — vanishing into the orbit-4 dub delay and big room. 24db filter smolders over 32 cycles; ply-doubled echo fills every 8 bars. chords.electro.aquatic.01 | stem | electro drexciya chords aquatic watery detuned phaser minor7 lush underwater shimmer deep-sea pads stabs detroit dreamy | - | Watery detuned minor-seventh chords in G# minor — saw voicings cycling G#m7 Emaj7 F#7 Bmaj7, jux-detuned so the right channel shimmers a few cents sharp, swept by a slow phaser like light through water. chords.electro.aquatic.02 | stem | electro dub stabs offbeat skank bubble square delay aquatic chords drexciya minor plucky underwater detroit hypnotic | - | Offbeat square-wave dub stabs in G# minor — short plucked triads on the upbeats cycling G#m C#m Em(add) F#, each stab released into a dotted-eighth delay so bubbles trail up behind it, light phaser wobble. The skanking counterpart to the detuned wash.
chords.gamelan.balafon.01 | stem | balafon gamelan xylophone wooden mallet marimba west african ostinato cyclic pentatonic slendro hypnotic rippling interlocking warm world chords reich bright | - | A rippling balafon ostinato in Db slendro-approx with West-African parallel-octave voicing: a main 8th-note figure, a bass goal-tone shifting each cycle, and an upper counter-line, together spelling a cycling pentatonic harmony. chunk(4) sweeps a reversal through the pattern quarter by quarter (full) while sparse leans on iter rotation; peak widens to a 16th hocket with an off() fifth-canon for instant counterpoint.
chords.gamelan.balafon.02 | stem | balafon gamelan xylophone wooden mallet west african triplet shuffle hocket call and response ostinato pentatonic slendro loping warm world chords syncopated cyclic | - | A loping triplet-shuffle balafon built from elongation ([x@2 x]) instead of straight 8ths, with a call-and-response mask that hands the phrase between a lower main figure and a masked upper answer each cycle. The bass goal-tone walks a four-cycle progression; peak tightens into a two-hand hocket with ply accents and an off() fifth-canon. A rounder, more syncopated cousin to the .01 ripple.
chords.gaze.wall_detune.01 | stem | shoegaze dreampop dream-pop chords detuned saw sawtooth wall-of-sound mbv bloom filter hazy euphoric 90s noise-pop blurred lush major glide | - | A wall of detuned sawtooth chords in C#/Db major (I-V-vi-IV) blooming under a slow 24-32 cycle filter. A superimposed micro-detuned copy thickens every chord into a beating haze; full re-triggers and pumps, peak adds a second flat-detuned layer and seventh voicings. Classic MBV smear.
chords.gaze.wall_detune.02 | stem | shoegaze dreampop dream-pop chords tremolo detuned saw sawtooth glide mbv shimmer bright hazy 90s noise-pop wall-of-sound picked stereo kevin-shields | - | A brighter, tremolo-picked cousin: the same detuned-saw wall re-triggered eight times a bar (glide-guitar tremolo) over a minor-leaning vi-IV-I-V progression in C#/Db. chords.house.organ_stab.01 | stem | house classic house organ M1 stab chords offbeat piano house 90s anthemic club keys harmonic uplifting | - | Korg-M1-flavored offbeat organ stabs on vcsl organ_full: Gm7 / Ebmaj7 / F7 / Dm7 progression alternating per cycle, struct-pulled offbeats, filter drifting over 32 cycles, ply fills every 8 and iter rotation at peak.
chords.house.organ_stab.02 | stem | house gospel house deep house organ swell chords sustained pump warm soulful church keys bed harmonic | - | Sustained gospel-house sibling: held organ_8inch chords re-triggered 4x per cycle for the pump (Gm9 / Cm9 / Ebmaj7 / D7 with harmonic-minor F#), attack swells in the sparse, chunked ply roll sweeping through the peak. A warm bed where the .01 is a percussive stab.
chords.house.piano_house.01 | stem | house piano house classic house piano stab chords offbeat italo 90s euphoric anthemic rave keys uplifting | - | Classic offbeat piano-house stabs in Eb major: voice-led Ebmaj7 / Abmaj7 / Cm7 / Bb7 alternating per cycle, struct offbeats, filter and room drifting over 32-64 cycles, octave off-canon and ply fills at peak.
chords.house.piano_house.02 | stem | house garage gospel house uk garage piano chords bounce swing syncopated soulful keys warm groovy 2-step | - | Gospel-garage sibling: anticipated push-beat piano in Eb major (Eb / Gm7 / Ab6 / Bb9 alternating), swung with a patterned .late grid, syncopated 8-step struct at peak with octave off-canon and lastOf doubles. Bouncier and more vocal-friendly than the .01 rave stab.
chords.idm.detuned_drift.01 | stem | idm braindance chords detune drift chorus phasing lydian dreamy hazy aphex boards-of-canada warm sawtooth evolving harmony | - | Bright B lydian chord drift: sawtooth voicings superimposed a fraction of a semitone apart for a slow phasing chorus, crawling a four-chord progression that re-triggers 4x per cycle so the saw pump breathes. Opposite-phase lpf and pan sweeps over 16-32 cycles; peak stacks a detuned octave shimmer. Hazy Boards-of-Canada haze with an Aphex edge.
chords.idm.detuned_drift.02 | stem | idm braindance chords detune drift chorus phasing lydian dreamy hazy aphex boards-of-canada dub sawtooth evolving spacious | - | Longer-form sibling of the detuned drift: sawtooth voicings superimposed a wide fraction apart for a slow phasing chorus, crawling an eight-chord B lydian progression (one chord per cycle) so the harmony evolves over eight bars, with a dotted echo tail the .01 lacks and a wider detune warble. Opposite-phase filter/pan sweeps over 24-40 cycles; peak stacks a detuned sub-octave.
chords.italo.brass_stabs.01 | stem | chords brass stabs italo hi-nrg disco synthwave offbeat anthemic euphoric 80s retro sawtooth progression night | - | Harvested from the stage-proven synthwave musicscene: its I-vi-IV-V anthem progression recast in D major (D Bm G A) as offbeat saw-brass stabs — voice-led triads, slow filter bloom, pumped offbeats, chunked hpf rotation and stab doubles at peak.
chords.italo.brass_stabs.02 | stem | chords brass stabs italo hi-nrg synthwave vowel formant night-drive yearning moody 80s retro echo syncopated | - | Minor-lean sibling of the brass stabs: vi-IV-I-V (Bm G D A) with a slow vowel formant morphing the saw brass between 'o' and 'e', syncopated double-hits and a dotted-eighth echo — yearning late-night flavor instead of anthem.
chords.jazz.ballad_piano.01 | stem | jazz ballad piano chords comping bb-major romantic torch-song late-night tender acoustic supper-club voicings classic | - | Slow piano ballad comping in Bb major: I-vi-ii-V voicings held with clip(1), gentle restrikes at phrase ends, octave shimmer canon at peak.
chords.jazz.ireal_comp.01 | stem | jazz comping chords ireal voicings stabs dorian bebop swing square rhythm-section classic syncopated club | - | Harvested square-wave comping through ireal voice-led changes in D dorian: Charleston-style struct, double-time comp bars every phrase, slow filter drift.
chords.jazz.ireal_comp.02 | stem | jazz comping chords ireal voicings dub delay smoky late-night spacious triangle mellow dorian ambient-jazz | - | Smoky late-set flavor: detuned triangle ireal voicings floating on long dub delays, off-beat struct, mask breathing every eight bars.
chords.latin.montuno.01 | stem | chords piano montuno guajeo latin salsa son mambo afrocuban cuban syncopated arpeggio bbmajor octaves bright groovy | - | A syncopated salsa piano montuno in Bb major: octave-doubled arpeggios outline an I-vi-IV-V guajeo (Bb Gm Eb F) that changes every cycle, with rests carving the clave-locked syncopation. Slow filter bloom, ply fills at phrase ends; peak double-times with an off-eighth octave shimmer and a chunked hpf rotation.
chords.latin.montuno.02 | stem | chords piano montuno guajeo block-chords latin salsa son mambo afrocuban cuban ii-V-I bbmajor syncopated call-response bright | - | A jazzier montuno voiced in two-note piano blocks (thirds and sixths) cycling a ii-V-I turnaround in Bb (Cm7 F7 Bb6) that changes every cycle, with a mask gating the guajeo out on the last bar of each phrase for call-and-response breathing. Peak adds a low-register left hand, off-eighth octave shimmer and a chunked hpf rotation.
chords.rave.piano_rave.01 | stem | piano rave stabs m1 house hardcore breakbeat euphoric anthem 1992 oldskool chords uplifting uk | - | The '92 anthem piano: offbeat C minor stabs walking Cm-Ab-Bb-Cm/G, struct-driven rhythm, isaw pump, octave-jump fills every 4 bars at peak. Pure Ecstasy-era euphoria.
chords.rave.piano_rave.02 | stem | piano rave breakdown dreamy emotional house hardcore euphoric anthem 1992 oldskool chords canon uplifting | - | The hands-in-the-air breakdown piano: sustained Ab-Eb-Bb-Cm progression with an octave-up delay canon via .off, blooming filter, driving straight-8 peak with phrase-end doubles.
chords.techno.detroit_stabs.01 | stem | techno detroit stabs chords m7 minor7 strings hpf classic driving soulful machine night | - | Classic Detroit string-machine stabs: C#m7 / AM7 / B7 / G#m7 progression alternating per cycle, syncopated struct hits, an hpf sweeping open over 32 cycles, dotted dub delay, saw gain-pump, ply doubles at phrase ends and an octave-echo canon at peak.
chords.techno.detroit_stabs.02 | stem | dub-techno techno chords dub basic-channel echo delay hazy deep minimal hypnotic chord-stab smoky | - | Basic-Channel flavor: a single C#m9 voicing struck once a bar and swallowed by long regenerating dub delay, chord swapped across a 4-cycle progression, filter opening and closing over 32 cycles, mask gating every other hit in sparse. Smoke and concrete where .01 is bright strings.
chords.trance.supersaw.01 | stem | trance uplifting supersaw chords wall detune pump sidechain anthem euphoric hands-up rave bloom filter-sweep | - | The big-room supersaw wall: quarter-note re-triggered detuned chords pumping on the isaw, I-vi-IV-V progression in E major, and a 32-cycle lpf bloom that opens the wall over half a minute. Peak adds 8th retrigs and an octave off-echo.
chords.trance.supersaw.02 | stem | trance uplifting supersaw stabs offbeat pluck detune pump bounce driving hands-up club chords | - | The bouncing sibling: plucky offbeat-8th supersaw stabs (rests on every kick) riding the top of the isaw pump, I-V-vi-IV progression, cosine lpf bloom in opposite phase to the .01 wall, and a fast(2) stab-roll on every 8th cycle. Peak rolls three stabs per beat.
chords.trap.dark_bells.01 | stem | trap drill hip-hop bells fm inharmonic chords dark eerie haunting metallic gothic minor cinematic night gamelan | - | FM bells at the inharmonic 2.76 ratio ringing a four-chord C# minor progression, with a masked music-box counter-melody and a polymeter bell cascade that drifts across bars at peak.
chords.trap.dark_bells.02 | stem | trap drill hip-hop bells gong fm inharmonic chords dread doom dark cinematic slow minor heavy ritual | - | Low-register sibling: slow gong-like FM strikes (same inharmonic 2.76 ratio, much longer decay) tolling a i-iv-i-V harmonic-minor progression, sub-bell pedal breathing under masked cycles.
chords.ukg.filtered_rnb.01 | stem | ukg uk garage 2-step rnb r&b chords sevenths stabs filtered sawtooth smooth soulful g major garage silky night | - | Close-voiced 7th-chord stabs on filtered sawtooth walking a G major I-vi-ii-V (Gmaj7 Em7 Am7 D7), slow 16-bar lowpass bloom, pump gain riding the beat, 9th extensions and stab fills at peak.
chords.ukg.filtered_rnb.02 | stem | ukg uk garage 2-step garage piano keys stabs chords sevenths todd edwards uplifting organic g major house classic bright | - | Bright offbeat piano 7th stabs, Todd Edwards style: G major I-vi-IV-V (Gmaj7 Em7 Cmaj7 D7), octave-echo canon, reversed phrase every 8 bars, slow filter shimmer. Clipped so nothing smears.
chords.vapor.mall_7ths.01 | stem | vaporwave vapor mallsoft chords keys piano pad maj7 maj9 lydian lush jazzy dreamy warm city-pop smooth-jazz lo-fi retro nostalgic hazy elevator | - | Lush ireal-voiced maj9/13 changes in F lydian (F^9 / G13 / Am9 / Dm9 — the G major over F is the lydian glow) blending a clip(1) acoustic piano comp against a soft sawtooth pad on opposite-phase filter breaths. Sparse holds the changes; full comps a syncopated struct; peak adds an octave-shimmer canon and a phrase-end nudge. Sunset food-court haze.
chords.vapor.mall_7ths.02 | stem | vaporwave vapor mallsoft chords keys rhodes electric-piano epiano fm maj9 lydian lush jazzy dreamy warm mellow lo-fi retro city-pop nostalgic hazy | - | An FM electric-piano (Rhodes) take on the same F-lydian maj9 changes, hand-voiced and movable via add-note: bell-toned comps with a slow FM-index breath so the timbre brightens and dulls over sixteen bars, an octave-up canon, and a peak that opens the filter, adds a fifth-canon and punches the FM index brighter each phrase end. Warmer, glassier and more intimate than the piano-pad blend.
chords.world.balafon_interlock.01 | stem | balafon marimba xylophone mallet wood west african african mandinka griot interlocking hocket pentatonic world chords polyrhythm sunny organic hypnotic | - | West-African balafon in a 12/8 interlocking hocket: two hard-mallet parts panned left and right trade complementary strokes that fuse into a continuous melodic cycle over G major pentatonic, riding a four-cycle progression. A soft low balafon anchors the bass, opposite-phase filter breaths shimmer the wood, and a lastOf(8) fill doubles the phrase. Peak cascades a rapid interlock with iter rotation. scale-sub transposable.
chords.world.balafon_interlock.02 | stem | balafon marimba xylophone mallet wood west african african mandinka polymeter cross rhythm phasing pentatonic world chords minimalism reich hypnotic organic | - | A hypnotic balafon built from cross-rhythmic polymeter cells: a five-note bright figure and a three-note soft figure stepped at the same pulse but of different lengths, so they drift against each other and realign only every fifteen cycles (Reichian). A low pentatonic ostinato grounds it, opposite-phase filter breaths shimmer the bars, iter and lastOf fills evolve it. Different device and mood from the hocket sibling. scale-sub transposable.
drums.acid.909_ride.01 | stem | 909 tr909 drums acid acid-house house techno ride clap four-on-the-floor rave driving classic chicago | - | Classic acid-house 909 backbone: four-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, ride-led 8ths riding a duck pump with slow lpf/pan drift. Clap rolls into 8-bar phrase ends; peak adds offbeat opens and a rotating rim euclid.
drums.acid.909_ride.02 | stem | 909 tr909 drums acid acid-house shuffle swing triplet toms rim hypnotic groovy techno house | - | Shuffled sibling of the acid ride: triplet-feel ride and hats via elongation ([rd@2 rd]*4), rim-tinted claps, and a rotating tom figure that walks around the bar with iter. Swings where .01 drives straight; darker and more hypnotic.
drums.afrobeat.bell_128.01 | stem | afrobeat highlife afro afro-funk tony allen 12/8 compound bell cowbell gankogui euclid polyrhythm west african drums rolling hypnotic organic roland tr707 ghost-notes groovy | - | Compound 12/8 afrobeat engine: a euclid (7,12) gankogui bell rotating Reich-style over the cowbell, TR707 kick on the four dotted pulses, rotating Tony-Allen ghost snares and triplet hats breathing under a slow filter sweep.
drums.afrobeat.bell_128.02 | stem | highlife afrobeat afro dance-band burger-highlife ghanaian 4/4 bell cowbell son-clave euclid drums bright uplifting danceable roland tr707 offbeat open-hat groovy sunny | - | The straight dance-band / burger-highlife cousin: son-clave-ish TR707 cowbell rotating every phrase, a 0-3-6 afro kick, backbeat snare and skippy offbeat open-hats — brighter and squarer than the 12/8 bell, with a filter breath and 4-bar hat fill.
drums.amapiano.sparse_four.01 | stem | amapiano drums four on the floor shaker shakers ghost notes 909 soft kick rim clap yanos private school afro-house south african sa-house spacious groove hypnotic | - | Soft 909 four-on-the-floor with lots of air around it, riding a busy sixteenth-note shaker layer whose per-step ghost-note gains give it the human amapiano sway. Offbeat rim in sparse; rim + clap on the backbeat and a masked open hat by peak. Space is the point.
drums.amapiano.sparse_four.02 | stem | amapiano drums private school shuffle swing shaker ghost notes rim toms 909 jazzy yanos afro-house south african sa-house loose dusty groove | - | A jazzier, swung take on the amapiano four: soft 909 kick under triplet-shuffle shakers ([sh@2 sh] elongation) with ghost-note gains, a syncopated late-swung rimshot conversation, and rolling Visco tom accents. Loose, human, dusty - the private-school pocket.
drums.concrete.thuds.01 | stem | musique-concrete found-sound drums framedrum cajon darbuka hand-drum thud euclidean irregular ritual tribal experimental dark organic off-grid | - | Concrete drum kit from hand-drum bodies: framedrum and cajon thudding across irregular rotating euclids, darbuka ghost fills, an oceandrum sub-wash bed, iter drift and phrase-end plies. Dark, ceremonial, off-grid.
drums.concrete.thuds.02 | stem | musique-concrete found-sound drums anvil brakedrum metal industrial forge thud euclidean irregular machine experimental harsh mechanical clang | - | Industrial concrete kit: anvil and brakedrum hammering irregular rotating euclids through heavy waveshaping, framedrum ghost body, ratchet accents, iter drift and plied fills that ramp <2 3>. Harsh, mechanical, forge-hot.
drums.disco.four_pump.01 | stem | disco 909 four-on-the-floor drums kick clap ghost-notes funky dancefloor 70s 80s driving classic synth-funk pump | - | Harvested stage groove: 909 four-on-the-floor with clap on 2&4, offbeat open hats, ghost-note 16th hats, and a rotating uzu cowbell euclid. Hat filter breathes over 16 cycles, ply fills punctuate every 4/8-bar phrase end, crash gates every 4th cycle at peak.
drums.disco.four_pump.02 | stem | disco 909 shuffle swing drums four-on-the-floor toms rimshot strut funky boogie dancefloor retro groovy | - | Sibling flavor: triplet-shuffle four-floor. Elongation-swung hats ([hh@2 hh]), 909 snare instead of clap, walking rim euclid that rotates through 16 positions, and pitched uzu tom pickups masked to phrase ends. Rowdier, more strut than gallop.
drums.disco.linn_boogie.01 | stem | boogie linn linndrum 80s disco synth-funk drums swing shaker electro-funk roller-rink retro groovy midtempo | - | AkaiLinn 80s boogie: kick on 1 and the and-of-3, layered snare+clap on 2&4, late-patterned swung 8th hats, uzu shaker 16ths that breathe out every 8th cycle, rotating cowbell euclid. Peak flips the kick to four-floor with snare-roll phrase fills.
drums.dnb.amen_roller.01 | stem | jungle dnb drum and bass amen breakbeat break chopped roller rolling drums hardcore raw uk energetic 1994 ragga dark | - | The jungle backbone: clean-breaks amen looped and chopped into a rolling groove — a 32-cycle filter tide, iter rotation walking the chop each cycle, reverse fills every 8 bars, and a peak that drops a 909 kick under spliced double-time rolls.
drums.dnb.amen_roller.02 | stem | jungle dnb drum and bass amen breakbeat break chopped edit slice rolling drums hardcore raw uk choppage 1994 dark | - | A rougher amen edit: explicit slice reorders with <a b> alternations that rewrite the break bar to bar, snare rolls bracketed at phrase ends, reverse fills — a chopped-up jungle 'edit' feel versus the smooth loopAt roller.
drums.dnb.twostep_break.01 | stem | dnb drum and bass jungle 2-step two-step breakbeat break drums 909 uzu rolling liquid uk driving club 1996 | - | Classic 2-step drum & bass: 909 kick on the one and the skip, snare on the backbeat, ghost-dynamic hats sweeping over 32 cycles, an open-hat euclid rotation, and a chopped uzu 'brk' loop laced through the top. Reverse/double-time fills bloom every 8 bars.
drums.downtempo.sp12.01 | stem | boom-bap hip-hop downtempo trip-hop sp12 sp-12 lofi dusty drums breakbeat head-nod 90s golden-era swing shuffle smoky | - | Classic SP-12 lo-fi boom-bap harvested from the stage-proven 808 hiphop scene: ghost-kick before the snare, triplet-shuffled hats with ghost-note gains, offbeat open hat breathing on a 4-bar mask, clap euclid walking across phrases.
drums.downtempo.sp12.02 | stem | halftime boom-bap downtempo trip-hop sp12 sp-12 lofi dusty drums rimshot dub smoky night slow hypnotic instrumental-hip-hop | - | Halftime SP-12 groove led by dubbed-out 707 rimshots walking a rotating euclid: snare only on beat three, pitched-down dragging hats, everything soaked in slapback. Sparser and moodier than the .01 head-nodder.
drums.drill.bounce.01 | stem | drill uk-drill trap hip-hop 808 drums bounce tresillo ghost-notes dark cold london chicago sliding halftime | - | UK drill kit built on the tresillo 3-3-2 kick with a euclidean ghost-kick layer that walks around the bar, skippy hats, and snare drags punctuating 8-bar phrases.
drums.dubtech.soft_four.01 | stem | dub techno techno dub deep minimal drums four on the floor 909 707 hats hypnotic smoky warehouse basic channel night soft | - | Muffled 909 four-on-the-floor under hazy 707 sixteenth hats; slow filter drift, breathing hat mask, phrase-end ply fills. Harvested from the autopilot dub scene's soft-kick arrangement, rebuilt for deep techno.
drums.dubtech.soft_four.02 | stem | dub techno techno dub shuffle swing triplet drums four on the floor 909 707 shaker polymeter hazy humid deep hypnotic night | - | Triplet-shuffled dub techno four: soft 909 kick, elongation-swung 707 hats, drifting polymetric shaker/tambourine cell and a distant clap ghost — hazier and more humid than the straight sibling.
drums.electro.linn_808.01 | stem | electro drexciya 808 tr808 linn linndrum drum-machine machine-funk breakdance detroit robotic syncopated old-school aquatic drums beat | - | Syncopated TR-808 electro kick/clap chassis with LinnDrum pickup fills, ghost-gain 808 hats panning slowly across the stereo field, and phrase-end double-time fills. Classic machine funk for deep-sea electro.
drums.electro.linn_808.02 | stem | electro drexciya halftime 808 tr808 linn linndrum drum-machine deep abyssal aquatic spacious dark dub drums toms | - | Halftime deep-sea electro: sparse heavy 808 kick, LinnDrum rim/clap backbeat on the 3, submerged 808 tom fills panning past like sonar contacts. Dark spacious pressure-hull groove.
drums.electro.rz1_crisp.01 | stem | electro casio rz1 digital 12-bit crisp lofi drum-machine drexciya miami freestyle robotic tight drums beat machine-funk | - | Casio RZ-1 12-bit digital electro kit: tight crunchy kick syncopation, snappy clap/snare backbeat, crisp ghost-note hats, a ride that swells in and out over 32 cycles, and a masked tom fill that only surfaces at phrase ends.
drums.exp.polymeter_kit.01 | stem | polymeter polyrhythm experimental idm techno 909 drums kit drift reich hypnotic driving cross-rhythm abstract club percussion phasing minimal dance | - | A TR-909 kit split across drifting polymeters: a {bd sd hh}%5 core wheels against a {hh oh}%4 hat lattice, so the two grids realign only every few bars while a steady backbeat clap anchors the crowd. Slow filter blooms, phrase-end ply/late fills, and an isaw hat-pump breathe over long spans. Peak drops a four-on-floor under the drift for the dancefloor.
drums.exp.polymeter_kit.02 | stem | polymeter polyrhythm experimental idm lo-fi casio rhythmace drums kit drift clave hypnotic dusty cross-rhythm abstract minimal reich percussion downtempo | - | A dusty CasioRZ1/RhythmAce cousin of the polymeter kit: a wide {bd sd rim}%7 grid grinds against a {hh oh hh}%3 hat cell for a long, slowly walking realignment, held together by a rotating euclid clap-clave. Sparser and more hypnotic than the 909 version, with a cosine filter tide and lo-fi grit. Peak adds a half-time kick pulse under the machinery.
drums.footwork.clap_storm.01 | stem | footwork juke claps clap hats storm burst ratchet 808 frantic energy chicago ghetto-house | - | Rapid 808 clap bursts driven by cycling ply ratchets over rotating euclid hats — restrained clap skeleton at sparse, full-on battle-circle clap storm with degrade chaos at peak.
drums.footwork.triplet_grid.01 | stem | footwork juke chicago drums kick 808 triplet polymeter ghetto-house fast frantic dance battle | - | 160bpm juke kick on the 3+3+2 grid with polymeter hats sliding across the bar, triplet hat clusters, and a 4-cycle kick phrase that erupts into triplet rolls at peak.
drums.footwork.triplet_grid.02 | stem | footwork juke drums bounce ghost-notes rimshot cowbell 808 swing shuffle chicago dark | - | Darker juke bounce: 6-over-8 polymeter kicks that drift and realign, swung elongated hats, rimshot chatter and 808 cowbell rotations at peak — a meaner sibling to the triplet grid.
drums.gamelan.gong_cycle.01 | stem | gamelan javanese indonesian gong colotomic gongan kenong metallic bronze bells meditative ritual ceremonial cyclic hypnotic mallet world gong ageng drums | - | A slow Javanese colotomic gongan: the great gong ageng sounds once every four cycles, kenong and kempul (gong2 + agogo) mark the interior subdivisions, and a steady kethuk woodblock pulse breathes on opposite-phase pan/lpf sweeps over 48 cycles. Sparse is the skeletal gong+kethuk frame; full fills the colotomic ensemble with a kethuk flurry every 8 bars; peak doubles the gong and spins agogo/slitdrum euclid rotations through the weave.
drums.gamelan.gong_cycle.02 | stem | gamelan balinese gong kebyar lancaran gong colotomic phasing handchimes brakedrum metallic festive processional shimmering bright cyclic reich bells world drums driving | - | A brighter, faster lancaran-style colotomic frame: the gong ageng returns every two cycles, brakedrum kethuk drives underneath, and two handchime layers run a Reich phase (one at fast(64/63)) so the metal shimmer slowly slips and realigns over ~63 cycles. Peak throws in a sus_cymbal euclid rotation and masked handchime bursts for gong-kebyar sparkle.
drums.gaze.wash_kit.01 | stem | shoegaze dreampop dream-pop drums kit tr707 roland washy soft reverb hazy backbeat 90s noise-pop blurred wall-of-sound buried-beat dreamy wet | - | A soft RolandTR707 kit drowned in deliberate room: buried kick/backbeat with washy closed+open hats, a slow filter breath over 32 cycles, gentle onset pump and a double-time fill every eighth bar. The beat sits under the haze, MBV-style.
drums.gaze.wash_kit.02 | stem | shoegaze dreampop dream-pop drums half-time tr707 roland toms brushed reverb spacious hazy 90s slowcore washy tribal dreamy soft buried-beat | - | A slower, even washier RolandTR707 flavor: half-time kick with a distant rim/snare backbeat, soft toms rolling under the haze, brushed hats and a reversing fill every four bars. More spacious and tribal than its sibling — Slowdive at 3am.
drums.glitch.crackle_kit.01 | stem | glitch clicks-and-cuts idm microhouse minimal noise crackle hiss drums kit percussion dusty brittle lowercase experimental oval pole electronica abstract hypnotic textural | - | A percussion kit grown entirely from noise oscillators: a continuous high-passed pink-hiss floor (the tape-hiss backbone), a brown-noise thud kick under a slow filter sweep, bandpassed white-noise snaps walking a rotating euclid, and pink ghost ticks with per-step accents over a crackle dust bed. Oval/Pole clicks-and-cuts groove where the hiss and crackle are the connective tissue; masks breathe, phrase ends ply into fills.
drums.glitch.crackle_kit.02 | stem | glitch idm clicks-and-cuts bitcrush crush coarse digital noise crackle drums kit percussion brittle broken frantic autechre experimental aliased lo-fi | - | The crackle kit's brittle digital cousin over a coarse low brown hum: a downsampled brown kick, bitcrushed white-noise snaps on a rotating euclid, aliased pink hats stuttered by ply, and crackle dust. Where .01 is dusty and analog, this one is broken-sample-rate glitch — chunked ply fills and crush drive a frantic Autechre-leaning groove.
drums.gqom.broken_kicks.01 | stem | gqom sgubhu south-african durban club dark broken displaced kick drums tribal hypnotic underground night visco | - | Displaced ViscoSpaceDrum kick clusters that never land on a straight four — four different sgubhu cells rotate over 4 cycles, 808 ghost hats pan-drift on a slow sine, ply fills punctuate every 8 bars. Dark Durban club pressure.
drums.gqom.broken_kicks.02 | stem | gqom sgubhu south-african 808 deep dark kick drums iter rotating swing club heavy underground | - | Deep 808 take on the broken-kick brief: a 3-3-2 kick cell walks around the bar via iter(8) so the displacement itself slowly rotates, pitched-down lt toms answer, micro-late hats add drag swing. Heavier and slower-feeling than the Visco sibling.
drums.house.classic_909.01 | stem | house classic house chicago 909 four-on-the-floor kick hats clap club dance driving warm 90s drums | - | Harvested classic-house 909: four-on-floor kick, offbeat open/closed hats, clap on 3, roll fills every 8 bars, hat filter drifting over 32 cycles. Kept the character of the stage-proven house scene.
drums.house.classic_909.02 | stem | house jackin chicago 909 jack four-on-the-floor shuffle snare raw gritty club dance drums energetic | - | Raw Chicago jack flavor: harder-shaped 909 kick, shuffled triplet-elongation hats, snare backbeat instead of clap, open-hat euclid slowly rotating, lastOf roll punctuation. Grittier and more percussive than the .01 classic.
drums.house.deep_707.01 | stem | house deep house 707 shuffle swing rimshot deep smoky late night warm drums kick hats understated | - | Deep-house TR707 kit: soft round kick, triplet-elongation shuffled hats, rimshot euclid that slowly rotates, roomy clap. Peak adds ghost-note rim 8ths rotating via iter and panning hats.
drums.idm.broken_splice.01 | stem | idm braindance breakbeat break funkydrummer splice glitch chopped drums aphex autechre electronica angular jungle stutter 90s | - | Funky Drummer break splice-rearranged through four rotating slice orders, glitch ply fills firing at the end of every 4-cycle phrase, a masked RolandTR707 kick reinforcing the pocket, and a 32-cycle filter tide. Angular Aphex chop with familiar 4-bar grammar underneath.
drums.idm.broken_splice.02 | stem | idm braindance breakbeat amen splice reverse backmask glitch drums dark dubby jungle lofi sp12 chopped moody | - | Darker amen splice: one cycle in four plays the whole break fully reversed, an EmuSP12 kick walks a rotating euclid underneath, dubby low-passed sparse variant. Moodier, heavier sibling of the think scramble.
drums.idm.rz_skitter.01 | stem | idm braindance glitch casio rz1 digital 12-bit skitter micro iter drums aphex autechre angular robotic crisp | - | CasioRZ1 12-bit micro-kit whose kick/rim cell rotates one step per cycle via iter(4) so the groove walks over four bars, crisp 16th ghost hats saw-pumping under it, a phrase-end ply fill, and a 32-cycle filter breath. Skittering braindance funk that never repeats the same bar twice.
drums.idm.rz_skitter.02 | stem | idm braindance glitch 707 roland casio rz1 shuffle triplet skitter iter dub drums aphex autechre woozy | - | Moodier sibling of the RZ-1 skitter: a RolandTR707 kick/rim cell iter-rotating over four bars, triplet-shuffle CasioRZ1 hats (elongation swing, no banned .swing), dub delay in the sparse skeleton, and a tom euclid surfacing at peak. Half-lit, woozy, head-nodding braindance.
drums.italo.four_cr.01 | stem | drums italo hi-nrg disco four-on-the-floor claps compurhythm cr1000 drum-machine 80s retro driving euphoric night dancefloor | - | Driving CR-1000 four-on-the-floor with big claps on 2+4, pumping offbeat hats under a slow hpf sweep, ply fills at phrase ends and a masked breath every 8th cycle.
drums.italo.four_cr.02 | stem | drums italo hi-nrg electro four-on-the-floor casio rz1 drum-machine digital crisp 80s retro tight polymeter dancefloor | - | Tight Casio RZ-1 four-floor: crunchy digital kick, polymeter hat engine that drifts and realigns every 3 cycles, ghost-gain 16th hats and a crash every other cycle at peak.
drums.jazz.brushes.01 | stem | jazz brushes drums tr707 ghost-notes swing combo lounge smoky acoustic shuffle supper-club mellow classic | - | Harvested TR707 jazz kit: ghost-note gain patterns on hats and snare, rim accents, phrase-end double-time fills, slow hat-filter drift.
drums.jazz.brushes.02 | stem | jazz brushes drums shaker shuffle triplet acoustic uzu soft late-night organic swing ballad warm | - | Acoustic uzu kit brushed with shaker-shuffle triplet elongation, dub-delayed rim, call/response mask breathing, phrase-end fills.
drums.jazz.ride_swing.01 | stem | jazz swing ride cymbal drums spang-a-lang bebop shuffle triplet combo uptempo acoustic brushy classic | - | Ride-led swing: spang-a-lang triplet elongation on uzu ride, pedal hat on 2 and 4, feathered kick, rotating euclid snare comping, crash phrase heads.
drums.jungle.fs_breakchop.01 | stem | amen break breakbeat jungle dnb drums chopped frenetic raw rave hardcore 909 rolling energetic | - | Chopped amen break rolled over two cycles with every-bar re-slice and reverse fills, reinforced by a 909 backbeat — the jungle engine from full_show (clean:2 rebuilt onto a legal named break).
drums.jungle.fs_breakchop.02 | stem | think break breakbeat jungle dnb drums chopped funky dusty 808 rolling raw amensibling groove | - | The Think break chopped and filter-swept over two cycles with an 808 backbone — a dustier, funkier flavor of the chopped-break engine.
drums.latin.songo.01 | stem | drums songo latin afrocuban cuban salsa clave conga tumbao cascara cowbell polymeter changuito timba organic groovy | - | Cuban songo groove: a son clave 3-2 rimshot anchor alternates its two bars via angle-brackets while uzu toms voiced as congas walk a 5-note polymeric tumbao that drifts against the 8th grid. Syncopated bombo kick, backbeat snare, pumped cascara hats and a mambo cowbell in the peak.
drums.rave.apache_stomp.01 | stem | apache break breakbeat rave hardcore 909 kick stomp oldskool 1991 drums driving warehouse uk | - | Apache break riding on a 909 four-on-floor stomp: chopped break with 32-cycle filter arc, clap on the 3, ply stutter fills every 4 bars and offbeat open hats at peak.
drums.rave.think_break.01 | stem | breakbeat break think chopped rave hardcore oldskool jungle 1992 drums warehouse energetic raw uk | - | Classic '92 hardcore think break: loopAt+chop groove with a 32-cycle filter arc, 8-bar reverse fills, and a peak that drops a 909 four-on-floor under spliced re-orders.
drums.rave.think_break.02 | stem | breakbeat break think shuffle rave hardcore oldskool jungle hypnotic phasing rolling drums 1992 uk | - | Hypnotic think-break walker: iter rotation makes the chop start-point crawl through the break Reich-style, patterned .late swing, ply stutter fills every 8 bars, chunked hpf bite at peak.
drums.reggaeton.dembow.01 | stem | drums reggaeton dembow perreo latin 808 rolandtr808 cinquillo tresillo boom-ch-boom-chick clap drum-machine club dancefloor driving urban | - | The reggaeton dembow: 808 kick on 1 and 3 interlocked with the snare/clap cell so kick+snare spell the 3+3+2 cinquillo (boom-ch-boom-chick). Offbeat hats pump under a slow hpf sweep, an alternating kick pickup on the last beat, and ply fills at phrase ends. Peak adds open hats and a double-time turnaround.
drums.reggaeton.dembow.02 | stem | drums reggaeton dembow perreo latin 808 rolandtr808 cinquillo tresillo triplet-swing timbale rimshot dark club urban trap | - | A darker perreo take on the dembow: a boomy low-passed 808 kick on 1 and 3 interlocks with the snare to spell the 3+3+2 (boom-ch-boom-chick), but the hats swing as triplets via elongation and a timbale rimshot ghosts the backbeat. Peak opens into 16th hat rolls with a double-time turnaround.
drums.techno.broken_cr1000.01 | stem | techno broken broken-beat electro compurhythm cr1000 syncopated dark machine vintage drums warehouse | - | Broken techno on the RolandCompurhythm1000: tresillo-leaning kick that mutates across a 4-cycle alternation, displaced snare answers, ply-stuttered offbeat hats under a slow filter drift, uzu cowbell rotation and doubled-time fills at the 8-bar seam.
drums.techno.warehouse.01 | stem | techno warehouse industrial berlin 909 four-on-the-floor kick tuned-kick pounding dark driving hypnotic rave drums | - | Tuned penv sine kick welded under a TR909 four-on-floor (harvested from the stage-proven autopilot techno scene): pumping offbeat hats under a 32-cycle filter drift, rotating 909 rim figure, cp backbeat, and a doubled-time fill closing every 8-bar phrase.
drums.techno.warehouse.02 | stem | techno warehouse tribal rolling ride toms hypnotic dark shuffle polymeter drums underground groovy | - | Hypnotic rolling flavor: boomy low-tuned penv kick, shuffled triplet-feel ride carrying the top end, polymetric uzu tom figure walking through iter, dropout fills that thin the phrase end instead of doubling it. Tribal-leaning where .01 is a straight pounder.
drums.trance.driving.01 | stem | trance uplifting 909 four-on-the-floor kick hats driving club rave euphoric peak-time drums dance 138bpm | - | Uplifting-trance 909 engine: four-floor kick, offbeat open hats riding a 32-cycle air sweep, ghost 16th hats with rush fills every 4 bars, claps on 2/4, and an 8-bar crescendo snare roll announcing each phrase.
drums.trance.driving.02 | stem | trance tech-trance techno 909 dark hypnotic rumble kick ride driving night warehouse drums | - | Darker tech-trance flavor: four-floor kick over a lowpassed ghost-kick rumble, Reichian euclid ride rotation walking across 4 cycles, rim syncopation, and an every-8-bars highpass kick-drop turnaround.
drums.trap.hat_rolls.01 | stem | trap drill hip-hop 808 drums hats hat-rolls rolls halftime dark bounce street atlanta southern modern club | - | Stage-harvested half-time 808 trap kit: boomy kick on 1 and the 7th eighth, clap on 3, hats that stutter into ply rolls with a slow brightness sweep and 8-bar double-time fills.
drums.trap.hat_rolls.02 | stem | trap hip-hop 808 drums hats shuffle triplet swing lazy smoky memphis screwed dark halftime hazy | - | Lazy triplet-shuffle sibling of the hat-rolls kit: elongation-swung hats that rotate through the bar via iter, 808 snare instead of clap, drowsy open-hat answers — codeine tempo swagger.
drums.triphop.dusty_break.01 | stem | trip-hop downtempo boom-bap hip-hop break funkydrummer breakbeat dusty lofi drums slowed chopped 90s smoky head-nod laid-back | - | The Funky Drummer break time-stretched to a crawl over four cycles and dusted down: chopped slices rotate with iter, a soft TR-707 kick and ghost-snare thump underneath, an opposite-phase filter breath, and 8-bar fills. Classic trip-hop head-nod.
drums.triphop.dusty_break.02 | stem | trip-hop downtempo dub break think breakbeat glitch drums murky dark dusty broken lofi echo 90s bristol | - | A darker, dubbier cousin: the Think break striated and glitch-slowed, drenched TR-707 rimshot echoes ghosting through the dub delay, random speed-drops dusting the loop, and a masked breakdown every fourth cycle. Murkier and more broken than the funkydrummer stretch.
drums.ukg.four_flavor.01 | stem | ukg uk garage 4x4 speed garage garage skippy hats shaker drums 909 707 bouncy club driving shuffle house | - | Four-to-the-floor speed-garage kit: pumping 909 kick, claps on 2 and 4, a 16th skippy 707 hat figure that rotates through the bar via iter, shaker euclid walking its offset, phrase-end clap doubles.
drums.ukg.two_step.01 | stem | ukg uk garage 2-step two-step garage shuffle swing skippy drums 909 707 london late night slinky groove club | - | Textbook UKG 2-step: 909 kick on the one plus the skip, snare on 2 and 4 with rim ghost swaps, 707 hats pushed late for shuffle, open-hat euclid slowly rotating its offset. Snare fills bloom at 4-bar phrase ends.
drums.ukg.two_step.02 | stem | ukg uk garage 2-step garage dark dub dubby rimshot ghost notes drums 909 707 moody underground night bus swing | - | Moody dub-garage 2-step: sparser 909 kick, clap-plus-snare layered backbeat, rim ghosts skipping through a rotating euclid with dubby delay, closed hats breathing under a slow filter drift. Low tom answers at peak.
drums.vapor.slow_505.01 | stem | vaporwave vapor mallsoft drums drum-machine tr505 roland 505 lo-fi lofi retro 80s hazy slow laid-back chill reverb wet nostalgic dreamy | - | A laid-back RolandTR505 kit floating in room reverb: skeletal kick/snare that alternates its footprint every other bar, breathy pumped hats panning against an opposite-phase filter breath, off-beat open hats that nudge late at phrase ends and an every-8 double-time fill. Macintosh-Plus haze drums, behind the beat.
drums.vapor.slow_505.02 | stem | vaporwave vapor mallsoft drums drum-machine tr505 roland 505 lounge bossa shuffle swing brush lo-fi retro warm hazy romantic elevator slow | - | A softer, brushed RolandTR505 groove with a triplet-elongation shuffle: gentle syncopated kick, clap on the backbeats, closed hats swinging on a [hh@2 hh] shuffle while an euclid-rotating closed-hat and open-hat pattern slowly walks its accents around the bar. Warmer and more romantic than the swim kit — cocktail-lounge vaporwave.
drums.world.mridangam_cycle.01 | stem | mridangam carnatic konnakol solkattu tala adi indian south-indian hand drum world percussion drums hypnotic organic acoustic cyclic raga meditative | - | Carnatic mridangam sarva-laghu in Adi tala (8 aksharas): sam alternates thom/dhum each cycle, a nam-dhin theka layer with ghost gains, a ki finger-stroke euclid that rotates through four positions, a slow filter breath and opposite-phase pan drift, and a lastOf(4) korvai that doubles the cycle at phrase ends. Peak walks the whole cycle with iter and a gumki slide.
drums.world.mridangam_cycle.02 | stem | mridangam carnatic misra chapu chapu tala 7/8 odd meter indian south-indian hand drum world percussion drums polyrhythm hypnotic cyclic acoustic raga | - | Mridangam theka in Misra Chapu tala, a lop-sided 7-beat cycle grouped 3+2+2. Accented sam alternates thom/dhum, a nam-dhin answer with 7-step ghost gains, a ki euclid (4,7) that rotates, opposite-phase filter and pan breaths, lastOf(4) doubling fills and an iter(7) that walks the seven-beat pattern one aksharam per cycle, realigning every seven bars.
lead.acid.hi_squelch.01 | stem | acid 303 lead squelch phrygian dark exotic resonant acid-techno techno rave hypnotic filter sawtooth | - | Octave-up 303 as a lead voice in G phrygian, leaning hard on the b2: iter-rotating squelch phrase with a deep lpenv ride, counter-phase lpf/lpq sweeps, dotted-8th style delay, and a reversed phrase every 8 bars. Peak adds a quiet octave canon.
lead.acid.hi_squelch.02 | stem | acid 303 lead siren square signal phrygian sweep rave acid-techno techno hypnotic rising deterministic | - | Signal-melody sibling: a square-wave phrygian siren built from sine.segment sampled into scale degrees — the line sweeps up and down every bar like a slow-motion 303 slide. Mask gating breathes call-and-response across cycles; deterministic.
lead.afrobeat.horn_riff.01 | stem | afrobeat highlife afro afro-funk horn horns brass horn-section stab riff fela e-major punchy sawtooth bold energetic call-and-response west african hook danceable | - | Punchy Fela-style horn-section stabs — short-short-long call figures following a I-vi-IV-V (E C#m A B) vamp, thickened by an off(1/8) harmony voice (default an octave down for a fat two-horn section) with a slow filter sweep and a 4-bar shout fill at peak.
lead.afrobeat.horn_riff.02 | stem | highlife afrobeat afro afro-jazz sax saxophone alto-sax horn solo melodic legato e-major wavetable expressive smooth soulful delay west african lyrical warm | - | The legato alternative to the horn stabs: a wavetable alto-sax singing a melodic line that climbs through the I-vi-IV-V (E C#m A B) changes, shadowed an octave below by an off(1/8) second horn, with tape delay, room and a slow filter sweep. Peak breaks into fast altissimo runs.
lead.amapiano.whistle_call.01 | stem | amapiano lead whistle pennywhistle kwela sine vibrato airy call melody yanos afro-house south african sa-house spacious dreamy minor | - | A lonely, airy sine whistle with vibrato calling over the amapiano groove in D minor, drenched in room and a dotted-eighth delay. Two alternating call phrases with call-and-response mask breathing; peak opens into a longer melodic run with an octave-up canon. Wide open and vocal, kwela-descended.
lead.amapiano.whistle_call.02 | stem | amapiano lead whistle pennywhistle kwela sine vibrato runs playful melody yanos afro-house south african sa-house bright lively minor | - | The playful, chattering side of the pennywhistle: fast kwela-style runs skipping up and down the D-minor pentatonic with a tight sixteenth-delay, brighter and more present than its airy sibling. Full runs a looping figure that speeds up every four cycles; peak turns virtuosic with an octave shimmer. Street-corner joy.
lead.concrete.siren.01 | stem | musique-concrete found-sound siren trainwhistle swoop doppler alarm air-raid lead sparse cinematic experimental tension industrial sound-effect glide | - | Sparse siren lead: air-raid siren swoops varispeed-pitched every couple of cycles, trainwhistle answering, a continuous doppler-glide siren panning across the field at peak, dub delay throws and reverse flips. Alarming, spacious, cinematic.
lead.concrete.siren.02 | stem | musique-concrete found-sound trainwhistle foghorn siren swoop ghost-train nautical lead sparse cinematic experimental mournful lonely sound-effect doppler | - | Mournful nautical concrete: trainwhistle foghorn calls pitched low by varispeed over a sub-octave siren drone, an arrange form drifting from distant to overhead across eight cycles, long delay and reverse flips. Lonely, foggy, cinematic.
lead.disco.clav_riff.01 | stem | lead clav clavinet riff funk disco square D-dorian stevie syncopated 70s keys groovy wah-adjacent | - | Harvested stage clav riff recast in D dorian via scale degrees: Stevie-style square-wave funk figure walking a Dm-G-F-C progression, slap-back delay, octave off-canon answer. Peak adds 16th pickups, iter(8) so the riff slowly walks around the bar, and octave lifts every 8th cycle.
lead.disco.clav_riff.02 | stem | lead clavinet clav wavetable polymeter phase reich funk disco D-dorian hypnotic weave percussive 16ths | - | Sibling flavor: real wavetable clavinet playing a 6-note motif as a polymeter against the 8th grid — the accent pattern phases and realigns every 3 cycles, Reich-style. A chunked hpf sweep walks through the pattern quarter by quarter; masked breath every 8th cycle; peak tightens to 16ths.
lead.disco.wt_guitar.01 | stem | lead guitar wavetable wt_eguitar disco funk lick chicken-scratch nile F-major plucky 70s rhythm-guitar dancefloor | - | Plucky wt_eguitar disco lick in F major over F-Dm-Gm-C: single-note funk line with double-stop pickups, slap-back delay, chuck-doubling ply fills every 8th cycle. Peak turns into 16th scratch phrasing that iter-walks around the bar with an octave off-canon shimmer.
lead.dnb.vibes_liquid.01 | stem | dnb drum and bass liquid liquid funk lead vibraphone mallet bells melody jazzy bb major dreamy weightless spacious elegant night cool | - | vcsl vibraphone singing a liquid drum & bass melody in Bb major: a spacious eight-bar line that iter-rotates and reverses at phrase ends, floated on a quarter-note delay and a pan tide, with octave off-echoes at peak. Dreamy, weightless, jazz-touched.
lead.dnb.vibes_liquid.02 | stem | dnb drum and bass liquid lead vibraphone mallet bells phasing reich minimal polymeter hypnotic bb major glassy meditative interlock | - | A hypnotic liquid interlock: a short Bb-major vibraphone cell in {}%4 polymeter drifting against the bar, doubled by a copy running fast(64/63) so the two phase apart and realign over 63 cycles — Reich in a dubwise delay. Minimal, glassy, meditative.
lead.downtempo.kalimba.01 | stem | downtempo trip-hop kalimba mbira thumb-piano mallet lead melody g-dorian dorian wistful organic world wooden bright nocturnal | - | A vcsl kalimba speaking a G-dorian line: sparse thumb-piano calls that answer themselves, iter rotation walking the phrase, a fifth-up canon via off, reversed phrase-ends and a slow pan-and-filter drift. Bright, wooden and wistful over downtempo.
lead.downtempo.kalimba.02 | stem | downtempo trip-hop kalimba mbira thumb-piano mallet lead interlock polymeter g-dorian dorian hypnotic trance-like cyclic world organic | - | A hypnotic Congotronics-style interlock: two and then three kalimba cells in cross-metric polymeter that drift and realign over long spans, opposite-phase filters, a chunked roll and octave canon at peak. Rhythmic and trance-like where the first kalimba was sparse and melodic.
lead.drone.super64.01 | stem | harmonica super64 reed lead melody drone ambient lonesome plaintive e-major delay call sparse cinematic wistful spacious | - | Sparse plaintive chromatic-harmonica phrases in E major, calling and falling silent across the drone, a dub delay answering each figure while the phrases lengthen from single cries at sparse to breathing melodic runs at peak.
lead.drone.super64.02 | stem | harmonica super64 reed lead melody runs drone ambient flowing scale e-major delay warm wistful cinematic spacious | - | Sibling to the lonesome calls: flowing diatonic chromatic-harmonica runs that climb and fall through the scale, rotating position every four cycles (iter) and answered an octave up by a delayed canon — warm and continuous where the calls were sparse. Scale-sub transposition, so it relocates to any root/mode from the sliders.
lead.electro.theremin.01 | stem | electro theremin eerie wavetable sci-fi lead swoop glide spooky abyssal deep-sea drexciya vintage b-movie haunting melodic | - | Eerie wt_theremin wavetable lead in G# minor — every note swoops up from below via a negative pitch envelope, drifting through a four-phrase melody arc while slow opposite sweeps move filter and pan like a searchlight through dark water. Peak adds a ghostly octave canon a quarter-cycle behind.
lead.electro.vocoder.01 | stem | electro vocoder robot talkbox vowel formant lead drexciya kraftwerk synth speech android detroit machine-funk melodic hypnotic | - | Vowel-swept robot lead in D minor — a talky sawtooth riff whose formant filter cycles a-e-i-o-u over five cycles while iter() rotates the melody through four positions, so mouth-shape and phrase drift against each other in a 20-cycle super-period. Peak doubles to 16ths with an octave canon.
lead.electro.vocoder.02 | stem | electro droid robot bleep chatter modem vowel square lead glitch transmission drexciya detroit staccato data machine | - | Chattering droid transmission in D minor — clipped square-wave bleeps gated through a rotating euclid (5,8) structure, tight i-u formants like a modem learning to speak, short slap delay. Mask gating opens and closes the channel; peak bursts into 16th-note data-stream with an octave shadow.
lead.exp.signal_weave.01 | stem | whole-tone signal segment lfo experimental ambient idm lead melody weave dreamy generative-feel impressionist scale interweaving hypnotic atmospheric cerebral modal | - | Two triangle voices spun straight out of LFOs: a sine.segment melody and a cosine.segment counter-melody sample the same waveshapes in opposite phase, so eight-against-six note grids interweave and drift. The home voice sits in C whole tone; the counter-voice cycles through lydian, whole tone and melodic minor so the harmony keeps sliding sideways. An octave-up off() canon and slow filter/resonance tides keep it evolving for minutes.
lead.exp.signal_weave.02 | stem | whole-tone perlin segment signal experimental dark idm lead generative weave phrygian harmonic-minor brooding nocturnal scale interweaving acid cerebral modal | - | The nocturnal sibling of the whole-tone weave: a perlin.segment lead wanders organically while a sine.segment counter-voice answers in opposite motion. The home voice still anchors on C whole tone, but the counter cycles phrygian and harmonic minor for a darker, more unstable pull, and a fifth-up off() canon thickens it. Resonant 24dB sawtooth, deep filter tides, generative (perlin) so no two passes are identical.
lead.footwork.chop_loop.01 | stem | footwork juke lead amen break chop slice micro-loop stutter jungle breakbeat frantic sampler | - | Sliced amen micro-loops in classic juke sampler style: obsessive slice-0 stutters mutate across a 4-group phrase, iter-rotated, pumping against the kick, reversing whole cycles at peak.
lead.footwork.chop_loop.02 | stem | footwork juke lead think break chop slice vowel talkbox vocal stutter breakbeat hypnotic | - | Sibling flavor: think-break slices pushed through a cycling vowel filter so the chops talk; polymeter slice indices drift across the bar, dub delay throws, apache trade-offs at peak.
lead.gamelan.tubular.01 | stem | tubularbells gamelan bells bell chime metallic bronze lead melody song pentatonic slendro contemplative spacious luminous meditative world ambient cinematic f# | - | A slow contemplative tubular-bells melody in F# slendro-approx: spacious phrases alternate over four cycles into a real bell song, with a quarter-note octave off() shimmer answering each stroke. Long delay tails and a slow lpf breath let the bronze ring; peak thickens into a fuller line with a double octave/fifth canon and iter rotation. Bell-metal lead for gamelan, downtempo, or ambient beds.
lead.gamelan.tubular.02 | stem | tubularbells gamelan bells bell chime carillon metallic bronze lead melody descending processional pentatonic slendro solemn funereal spacious world ambient cinematic | - | A lower, solemn tubular-bells processional: a descending F# slendro-approx melody unfolds over four cycles with deep 0.66-time delay tails and a very slow 48-cycle filter breath, half-cycle octave echoes trailing like a distant carillon. Peak spreads a double octave-up/octave-down canon through an iter rotation. The funereal counterpart to the .01 song.
lead.gaze.violin_haze.01 | stem | shoegaze dreampop dream-pop lead violin strings wavetable haze delay echo floating lydian ethereal 90s hazy dreamy melodic reverb | - | A hazy wavetable-violin line floating in A lydian under an enormous dub delay. Sparse breathes two-note sighs; full flows an eighth-note figure that rotates via iter over four cycles; peak arpeggiates with an octave-up canon echo. The raised fourth (D#) glows through the reverb.
lead.gaze.violin_haze.02 | stem | shoegaze dreampop dream-pop lead violin strings wavetable sighing mournful delay echo high ethereal 90s melancholy sparse reverb slowdive | - | A higher, sparser and more mournful wavetable-violin voice: long sighing held notes in upper A lydian, drowned in an even bigger delay and reverb, letting tails smear into the next phrase. Slower and more melancholy than its flowing sibling — the sound of a held breath.
lead.glitch.chip_stutter.01 | stem | glitch chiptune chip 8bit wavetable lead stutter ply arp arpeggio riff 16ths idm bleep sequence hypnotic digital ab-minor | - | A wt_oscchip 16th-note riff in Ab minor that walks an i-VI-III-VII progression while ply re-triggers stutter it across cycles, a 16-cycle filter breath opens and closes, and the pump gain ducks each beat. Peak layers an octave-up off canon and doubles to 32nds at phrase ends. Glitchy chiptune lead, wide stereo, dotted echo tail.
lead.glitch.chip_stutter.02 | stem | glitch idm bleep wavetable bitreduced lead granular stutter ply melodic digital dub eerie hypnotic lo-fi clicks-and-cuts chip ab-minor | - | A moodier granular cousin of the chip riff: a wt_bitreduced melody in Ab minor whose notes are shattered into 2-5x ply stutters, a chunk transform reverses a quarter of the pattern each cycle, and a 24-cycle filter breath drifts underneath. Slower and eerier than .01 — dub-delayed digital bleeps that phase between melody and granular noise. Peak adds a fifth-up off canon.
lead.house.vocal_vowel.01 | stem | house deep house lead vocal vowel chops diva synth sawtooth melodic hook catchy soulful filtered | - | Sawtooth 'vocal' chop lead in B minor: vowel filter cycling a-e-i-o-u like a chopped diva sample, scale-substituted for live transposition, mask call-and-response gating, iter rotation and octave off-canon at peak, delay tail owned on orbit 5.
lead.idm.segment_melody.01 | stem | idm braindance lead melody generative segment signal lydian square aphex autechre hypnotic angular evolving bright sequence deterministic | - | Generative B lydian lead sampled from slow signals into scale degrees: the full groove is n(sine.segment(16).range(0,14)) quantized to lydian with a per-note filter envelope for squelch body, the sparse skeleton reads a slower sine over eight steps, peak doubles at phrase ends with an octave off-canon. Mask gating breathes call-and-response; opposite-phase filter sweeps evolve over 16-32 cycles. Deterministic braindance.
lead.italo.euphoric_oct.01 | stem | lead italo hi-nrg synthwave octave jump euphoric anthemic square soaring delay 80s retro night hands-up | - | Harvested from the synthwave musicscene's square lead: low-high octave leaps riding a I-vi-IV-V progression in A major, dotted-eighth delay halo, walk-up fill on the V bar; peak is a two-section arrange that flips from jumps to a cascading descant.
lead.italo.euphoric_oct.02 | stem | lead italo hi-nrg gate trance-gate gated octave rhythmic anthemic sawtooth pulsing 80s retro dancefloor hands-up | - | Trance-gate sibling: octave dyads chopped into ghost-gained 8ths and 16ths instead of melodic leaps — a rhythmic gate that follows the same I-vi-IV-V progression, breathing via mask and lifting an octave at every 8th cycle.
lead.italo.wt_vgame.01 | stem | lead wavetable vgame chiptune chip videogame italo hi-nrg hook arcade 8bit euphoric bright 80s retro | - | Chip-adjacent wt_vgame lead in A major: an 8-note pentatonic-leaning hook that iter-rotates through the bar over 8 cycles, octave off-echo, dotted-eighth delay; jux-reversed stereo runs at peak.
lead.italo.wt_vgame.02 | stem | lead wavetable oscchip chiptune chip italo hi-nrg phasing reich call-response arcade 8bit hypnotic 80s retro | - | Colder chip sibling on wt_oscchip: two-phrase call/response alternation with masked answer bars, and at peak a Reich phase — the run against itself at 64/63, panned hard, drifting apart and realigning every 63 cycles.
lead.jazz.vibraphone_blue.01 | stem | jazz vibraphone mallet bells blues lead melody minor-pentatonic cool-jazz mjq jazzy nocturnal elegant vintage | - | vcsl vibraphone speaking a C minor-pentatonic blues line: sparse calls, answering runs, iter rotation, reversed phrase ends, octave sparkle at peak.
lead.jazz.vibraphone_blue.02 | stem | jazz vibraphone mallet bells swing shuffle call-response lead soft mellow lounge cocktail blues warm | - | vibraphone_soft in swung elongation pairs, conversational call-and-response gated by a mask; mellower and rounder than the .01 line.
lead.jazz.vibraphone_modal.01 | stem | jazz vibraphone mallet bells modal dorian canon counterpoint reich lead runs cool-jazz hypnotic elegant | - | vibraphone_soft running D dorian lines with an off() canon a fifth above; iter rotates the phrase Reich-style, reversed bars punctuate phrases, double canon at peak.
lead.jungle.fs_ravestab.01 | stem | rave stab lead jungle dnb hardcore square pentatonic bright energetic 90s oldskool riff playful | - | Bright square-wave pentatonic stab riff with 1/8 delay and a slow filter breathe — the darkcore/jungle rave lead from full_show.
lead.jungle.fs_ravestab.02 | stem | hoover rave stab lead hardcore oldskool jungle breakbeat mentasm sawtooth detuned euphoric nostalgic resonant | - | Detuned fifth-stacked sawtooth hoover stab with resonant filter sweeps — the euphoric oldskool-rave cousin of the square stab.
lead.latin.brass_stabs.01 | stem | lead brass horns stabs trumpet trombone mambo moña latin salsa sawtooth bbmajor punchy anthemic unison bright | - | A horn section in Bb major: punchy sawtooth brass stabs land on the syncopated mambo accents over an I-vi-IV-V vamp (Bb Gm Eb F) while a unison run answers in the gaps. Filter blooms across 16 cycles; peak widens the voicings to add-9 chords, fires 16th-note unison runs and throws a dotted delay.
lead.latin.brass_stabs.02 | stem | lead brass horns moña trumpet trombone salsa mambo latin legato unison melodic sawtooth bbmajor soaring bright | - | The moña: a legato octave-doubled horn line rather than stabs, weaving a continuous singable hook through an I-vi-IV-V vamp in Bb (Bb Gm Eb F) that turns over each cycle, drenched in dotted delay. Sawtooth section with a slow filter bloom; peak breaks into fast 16th unison runs that leap the octave.
lead.rave.mentasm.01 | stem | mentasm hoover lead rave hardcore riff stab dark aggressive belgian techno 1991 hpf sweep | - | Second Phase-style mentasm lead: detuned supersaw stabs riffing in F minor with the signature hpf sweep climbing over 32 cycles, dub-delay space when sparse, 16th frenzy at peak.
lead.rave.mentasm.02 | stem | mentasm hoover siren scream lead rave hardcore dark menacing belgian techno 1991 hpf airraid | - | The other mentasm: long siren screams up in octave 4-5 with huge pitch dives, call-and-response mask breathing, half-time pump — menace and air-raid drama over the riffy .01.
lead.techno.hoover_wt.01 | stem | techno rave hoover lead wavetable distorted mentasm 90s dark aggressive anthem synth warehouse | - | Mentasm-style hoover on wt_distorted: pitch-envelope drop on every attack, stereo micro-detune via jux, i-VII-VI-v swells in sparse, a two-bar rave riff alternation in full, octave-canon and reversed-riff fills at peak. Filter blooms over 8-32 cycles.
