lead.trance.anthem.01 | stem | trance uplifting anthem lead melody soaring delay echo euphoric hands-up epic emotional sawtooth gated | - | The hands-in-the-air moment: a soaring 8-cycle A-major melody in long notes, three-voice micro-detuned sawtooth, dotted-eighth delay wash, 32-cycle filter and 24-cycle pan drift, and a gated ply(4) stutter on every 4th cycle. Peak doubles the octave and gates harder.
lead.trance.wt_arp.01 | stem | trance uplifting arp arpeggio wavetable chip vgame canon 16ths lead sparkle euphoric hypnotic sequence | - | Chippy wt_vgame wavetable 16th arpeggio walking an i-VI-III-VII progression in F# minor, with an octave-up off(1/8) canon panned wide, a 16-cycle filter breath, and a dotted echo tail. Peak doubles to 32nds at phrase ends and sweeps twice as fast.
lead.trance.wt_arp.02 | stem | trance dream-trance progressive-trance arp cascade wavetable stringbox canon dreamy melancholic lead echo hypnotic | - | Dreamy sibling: falling wt_stringbox 8th-note cascades over an i-VII-VI-III progression, a fifth-above off(3/16) canon drifting right, 32-cycle cosine filter breathing and a long feedback echo. Peak doubles the cascade with ply and reverses phrase tails.
lead.trap.whistle.01 | stem | trap drill hip-hop whistle lead sine vibrato eerie haunting melody dark western lonely minor cinematic night | - | Vibrato sine whistle in F minor: two alternating phrases with call-and-response mask breathing, dubby delay tails, and an octave-up off() canon at peak — the lonely whistle over the beat.
lead.ukg.vocal_chops.01 | stem | ukg uk garage 2-step lead vocal vocal chops vowel formant diphone chops hook e minor soulful garage voice melodic | - | Vowel-filtered sawtooth sings a chopped E minor hook over four cycles while diphone syllable chops answer at shifting speeds, panning on a slow sine. Octave-echo sparkle and 4-bar chop doubles at peak.
lead.ukg.vocal_chops.02 | stem | ukg uk garage 2-step lead vocal vocal chops yeah choir voice chops stutter gospel e minor garage airy euphoric | - | Airy human-voice wavetable carries a vowel-morphing E minor line while classic 'yeah' sample chops stutter underneath, re-pitched by speed and sliced by chop. Gospel-garage stutter at peak with sparkle canon.
lead.vapor.sax_dream.01 | stem | vaporwave vapor mallsoft lead sax saxophone vcsl dreamy detuned tape wow slow smooth jazzy melodic warm wet reverb lo-fi retro city-pop romantic nocturnal | - | A slow, legato vcsl saxophone drifting long phrases in C major, detuned by a gentle sine wow signal added to the pitch (tape warble) and thrown into a wet dub delay. Sparse breathes one lyric note per cycle; full opens into four-bar phrases with an octave-lower shadow; peak sings expressive runs with a fifth-canon. Smoke-machine sax over an empty rooftop.
lead.vapor.sax_dream.02 | stem | vaporwave vapor mallsoft lead sax saxophone staccato stabs bluesy blues vcsl echo delay jazzy playful retro lo-fi wet nocturnal city-pop night | - | A playful, staccato vcsl saxophone spitting bluesy licks over C (blue notes eb/f#/bb) with a constant slightly-flat detune for worn tape character, short and wet in a tight dub echo. Sparse trades one stab per cycle across the rests; full plays a syncopated four-bar lick; peak rips a fast call-and-response run with a phrase-end double-time fill. Late-night neon and a smirk — the opposite of the dream sax.
lead.world.dantranh_bend.01 | stem | dan tranh dantranh zither koto guzheng vietnamese asian east asian pentatonic world lead plucked shimmer tremolo runs hypnotic elegant cinematic | - | Vietnamese dan tranh zither running E minor pentatonic phrases with an off() canon an octave up, a sustained dan_tranh_tremolo shimmer holding the mode, opposite-phase pan and filter breaths, iter rotation of the run and every() reversed-bar punctuation. Peak sends rapid glissando cascades. scale-sub transposable.
lead.world.dantranh_bend.02 | stem | dan tranh dantranh zither koto guzheng vietnamese asian east asian pentatonic world lead plucked vibrato bend call and response meditative spacious cinematic | - | A spacious, contemplative dan tranh in E minor pentatonic built as a two-section arrange() mini-form: a bending dan_tranh_vibrato 'question' phrase answered by a plucked dan tranh 'response', with a held tremolo pad beneath. Long echoes, opposite-phase filter and pan breaths, reversed-bar punctuation. Floating and meditative where the sibling runs. scale-sub transposable.
lead.world.ocarina_folk.01 | stem | ocarina flute whistle pipe wind folk celtic pastoral dorian canon round counterpoint world lead melody wistful cinematic village | - | A lilting 6/8 folk melody on ocarina in D dorian, shadowed by an off() canon a fifth above and, at density, a second canon an octave up — instant round-singing counterpoint. A low ocarina counter-line grounds it an octave down, opposite-phase filter and pan breaths drift, iter rotates the tune and every() reverses bars at phrase ends. scale-sub transposable.
pad.amapiano.dusk.01 | stem | amapiano pad warm dusk bloom sawtooth atmosphere chords sustained yanos private school afro-house south african sa-house nostalgic golden lush | - | A warm, lightly saturated sawtooth pad that blooms slowly through an F / Dm / Bb / C progression in F major with octave-reinforced voicings - the golden-hour glow behind the log drum. Sparse holds long slow-attack chords under a filter tide; full re-triggers twice a cycle with opposite-phase pan drift; peak runs a *4 re-trigger pump so the pad breathes under the kick.
pad.amapiano.dusk.02 | stem | amapiano pad night cool bloom sawtooth atmosphere shimmer sustained yanos private school afro-house south african sa-house mysterious deep lush | - | The cooler, after-dark counterpart to the dusk pad: a lightly saturated sawtooth wash centred on the relative minor (Dm / Bb / F / Am, still in F major) with octave-reinforced voicings and a soft octave-up shimmer floating over it like distant lights. Sparse blooms slowly; full adds the shimmer and a filter tide; peak runs a *4 re-trigger pump. Mysterious where the sibling is golden.
pad.concrete.wineglass.01 | stem | musique-concrete found-sound wineglass glass drone pad bowed ethereal shimmer ambient sustained crystalline experimental meditative atmosphere sacred | - | Bowed-glass drone: three wineglass voices tuned by varispeed into a root-fifth-octave chord with slow beating, one voice shimmering between glass samples each cycle, opposite-phase lpf and pan sweeps, marktrees sparkle at peak. Ethereal, shimmering, sustained.
pad.concrete.wineglass.02 | stem | musique-concrete found-sound wineglass glass gong cymbal drone pad dark ominous ambient sustained metallic experimental sacred foreboding | - | Ominous sub-octave drone: wineglass pitched down by varispeed under bowed suspended cymbal and slow gong swells, long attack and release, opposite-phase sweeps, gong euclid at peak. Dark, sacred, foreboding.
pad.disco.warm_juno.01 | stem | pad juno analog detuned sawtooth warm disco synth-funk F-major pump sidechain lush 80s dreamy chords | - | Detuned-saw Juno-style pad walking Fmaj7-Dm9-Gm9-C9, re-triggered quarter-note chords with the sanctioned saw gain-pump for light sidechain feel. Filter blooms over 32 cycles with counter-phase pan drift; peak adds octave off-shimmer and an hpf'd breakdown cycle every 8.
pad.disco.warm_juno.02 | stem | pad strings philly orchestral disco lush detuned sawtooth F-major cinematic sunrise 70s salsoul sweeping warm | - | Sibling flavor harvested from the stage strings scene: lush 3-voice detuned saw strings voiced high over F-Am7-Bbmaj9-Csus9, slow attacks, huge room. Gentle half-bar pump on full, masked breath every 8th cycle, 32-cycle filter bloom — orchestral disco sunrise rather than synth pump.
pad.dnb.dark.01 | stem | dnb drum and bass jungle pad dark brooding minor atmosphere drone tension g minor cinematic cold liquid neurofunk night | - | A brooding G-minor pad descending Gm-F-Eb-Dm, its top voice stepping down D-C-Bb-A. Sparse is a slow sustained drone with opposite-phase lpf and pan tides; full re-triggers 4x per bar so the isaw pump breathes with the kick, morphing vowels; peak widens the voicings and carves an hpf sweep.
pad.dnb.dark.02 | stem | dnb drum and bass pad dark drone detune bandpass hollow vocal atmosphere tension g minor reese cold liquid neurofunk submerged | - | An atmospheric G-minor drone: a detuned saw stack over a G pedal, its inner voice sliding while a bandpass tide sweeps the whole thing hollow. Vowel morphs give it a breathing, vocal quality. Sparse is a pure drone; full and peak re-trigger to pump and widen the cluster.
pad.downtempo.tape_warm.01 | stem | downtempo trip-hop pad tape warm detune saw strings ab-major smoky dark analog wow lush atmosphere nocturnal | - | A dark saw pad worn like old tape: two detuned voices where the second drifts on a slow sine-driven detune signal for tape wow, opposite-phase filter and pan sweeps, an octave-drop closing each eight-bar phrase and a re-triggered pump at peak. Ab-major smoke behind the beat.
pad.downtempo.tape_warm.02 | stem | downtempo trip-hop pad tape chorus detune shimmer lydian ab-major dreamy airy floating bright analog atmosphere ethereal | - | Brighter, dreamier tape: a triangle-and-saw chorus floating an Ab-lydian I-II vamp, the saw voice fluttering on a fast detune signal for shimmer, opposite-phase sweeps and an octave lift closing each phrase. Where the warm pad is dark smoke, this one is airy light.
pad.drone.bowed_vibes.01 | stem | vibraphone bowed mallet bells metallic drone ambient pad sustained e-major eerie meditative glacial spacious shimmer cinematic | - | Bowed-vibraphone clusters drifting through a slow I-IV-vi-V arc in E major, re-bowed twice a bar so the chords breathe, with a glacial filter, opposite-phase pan, and an octave-up shimmer canon at peak.
pad.drone.bowed_vibes.02 | stem | vibraphone bowed mallet bells metallic drone ambient pad euclid pulse e-major restless glinting hypnotic minimalism shimmer | - | Restless sibling to the bowed drift: bowed-vibraphone chords gated by a slowly-rotating euclid pulse that walks across the bar, glinting through a filter breath, pan drift, and an octave shimmer canon — an interference-pattern drone rather than a block-chord sustain.
pad.drone.partials_organ.01 | stem | organ additive partials sine harmonics drone ambient pad sustained c-lydian lydian bright warm meditative spacious church | - | An additive sine-partial organ drone: fast overlapping arpeggios ring into sustained chords (long release), breathing through a bright C-lydian arc (Cmaj7 / D / Em7 / Gmaj) as the harmonic spectrum thickens from sparse to peak and a glacial filter and pan keep it in slow motion.
pad.drone.partials_organ.02 | stem | glass additive partials sine hollow odd-harmonics clarinet drone ambient pad polymeter c-lydian lydian crystalline hypnotic minimalism | - | Sibling to the additive organ but glassy and hollow: odd-heavy sine partials arpeggiated through a drifting polymeter over C lydian, so the notes slowly walk out of phase with the bar and realign over many cycles while a filter and pan breathe underneath.
pad.dubtech.tape.01 | stem | dub techno techno dub ambient pad tape hiss dark vowel f# dorian dorian noise warm analog worn hypnotic deep smoky | - | Dark hissy F# dorian pad: slow-morphing vowel-filtered sawtooth chords (F#m7/B7/Emaj7/C#m7) with a brown-noise tape layer breathing underneath on the opposite phase; retriggers into a proper pump at peak.
pad.electro.deep_sea.01 | stem | electro pad deep-sea dark bandpass bpf drone underwater abyssal drexciya ambient atmosphere swell tide detroit brooding | - | Dark bandpass-swept pad in G# minor — sawtooth voicings drifting G#m Emaj7 F# and back, heard through a 32-cycle bpf tide that opens and closes like a thermocline. Sparse is a slow-breathing drone; full re-triggers in halves under a gain swell; peak pumps eighths with an octave lift at phrase ends.
pad.exp.partials_morph.01 | stem | additive partials pad drone experimental ambient lydian morph sine spectral evolving warm hollow reich atmospheric cinematic modal meditative texture | - | An additive sine drone whose spectrum keeps switching recipe. Two stacked voices share a C-lydian chord cycle but carry different partials: one the full harmonic series, the other odd-harmonics-only and hollow. Opposite <> masks trade them off cycle by cycle so the timbre morphs between rich and reedy while the chords progress, panned in opposite phase under a very slow filter bloom. Full/peak re-trigger (struct) so the bed breathes and, at peak, pumps.
pad.exp.partials_morph.02 | stem | additive partials pad drone experimental ambient lydian bells crystal glass morph sine spectral shimmer high evolving celestial music-box meditative | - | A crystalline high sibling of the lydian additive drone. Same C-lydian chord cycle, but the two stacked sine voices carry bell-and-formant partials (strong 2nd/4th) versus hollow reed partials (strong 3rd/5th), traded by opposite <> masks so the shimmer morphs between glassy and woody. Voiced an octave-plus up for a music-box wash; peak floats a c5-d6 top voice and pumps. Bright, weightless, evolving.
pad.gaze.reverse_swell.01 | stem | shoegaze dreampop dream-pop pad swell reverse saw sawtooth attack bloom ethereal hazy 90s euphoric lush dreamy sustained warm wall-of-sound | - | A sawtooth pad in C#/Db major with a long reverse-cymbal attack that re-triggers to swell up again and again. Chords move I-IV-V-ii while a slow filter breathes; full re-swells twice a bar, peak four times into a continuous blooming wash. Major-key euphoria under haze.
pad.gaze.reverse_swell.02 | stem | shoegaze dreampop dream-pop pad swell dark melancholy saw sawtooth low slowdive brooding 90s ethereal sustained wistful reverse deep nocturnal | - | A darker, lower-voiced reverse-swell pad: brooding ii-vi-IV-I motion in C#/Db, longer attacks and releases, dropped an octave at peak for a Slowdive-melancholy weight. Slower re-swells than its euphoric sibling, filter kept low and mournful under the reverb.
pad.gqom.dark_chant.01 | stem | gqom pad chant vowel choir drone dark phrygian vocal sa-club ominous ritual sustained atmospheric | - | Dark C phrygian chant pad: sawtooth power-dyads through an o/u vowel filter, progression Cm-Cm-Bb-Db over 4 cycles. Sparse breathes in whole notes; full re-triggers twice per cycle with a 32-cycle filter tide; peak runs the sanctioned *4 re-trigger pump so the choir ducks under the kick.
pad.gqom.dark_chant.02 | stem | gqom pad choir voice wavetable vowel ghost haunted chant phrygian dark airy atmospheric sa-club vocal | - | Spectral sibling of the sawtooth chant: wt_hvoice human-voice wavetable an octave up, u/o vowel filtering, Cm-Bb-Cm-Db drift with a quiet octave-up off() canon shadowing the full variant. Airier and more haunted than the .01 growl; peak runs the *4 re-trigger pump.
pad.house.dreamhouse.01 | stem | house deep house dream house pad lush ninth 9th warm dreamy bloom atmospheric sustained synth euphoric | - | Lush 9th-chord pad in Eb major (Ebmaj9 / Cm9 / Abmaj9 / Bb9sus alternating per cycle): slow-attack bloom in the sparse, re-triggered quarter pump in full, octave shimmer off-canon and ply swells at peak. Filter blooms over 16-32 cycles.
pad.house.dreamhouse.02 | stem | house deep house pad choir voice vocal pad wavetable airy breathy ethereal atmospheric sustained dreamy ambient | - | Airy sibling on the wt_hvoice human-voice wavetable: open add9/sus voicings in Eb major with a slow 8-cycle harmonic rhythm (two cycles per chord) in full, breathy swells in sparse, and a chunked ply roll that sweeps through the peak. Choral and weightless where the .01 is thick and saturated.
pad.idm.vowel_morph.01 | stem | idm braindance pad vowel morph formant choir vocal drone dark aphex boards-of-canada atmospheric evolving sustained hazy | - | Slow vowel-morphing sawtooth pad in D#/Eb minor: a five-vowel <a e i o u> sequence crawls across a five-cycle span while a four-chord i-VII-III-v progression re-triggers 2-4x per cycle. Opposite-phase lpf and pan sweeps over 16-32 cycles; peak runs the sanctioned saw-pump re-trigger so the choir ducks under the kick. Formant-shifting braindance haze.
pad.idm.vowel_morph.02 | stem | idm braindance pad vowel morph formant square nasal vocal alien aphex boards-of-canada atmospheric evolving hollow dark | - | Hollow square-wave sibling of the vowel morph in D#/Eb minor: a faster six-step <e a i o u a> formant sweep makes the pad almost talk, over a descending i-v-VII-III voicing that re-triggers 2-4x per cycle. Nasal and alien where the .01 is a warm saw haze. Opposite-phase sweeps evolve over 24-32 cycles; peak runs the saw-pump re-trigger.
pad.italo.strings.01 | stem | pad strings string-machine italo hi-nrg synthwave solina lush warm night 80s retro sawtooth pump cinematic | - | Harvested from the synthwave musicscene's held supersaw beds, recast as an F# minor string machine: i-VI-III-VII progression (F#m D A E), slow filter bloom against an opposite-phase pan drift; full and peak re-trigger 4x per cycle for the isaw pump.
pad.italo.strings.02 | stem | pad strings solina ensemble additive phasing reich shimmer italo synthwave dreamy melancholy night 80s chorus | - | Additive-sine ensemble strings on a darker i-VII-VI-v progression (F#m E D C#m), run as a Reich phase — the same bed against itself at 64/63 panned left/right, so the chorusing slowly deepens and realigns over 63 cycles.
pad.jazz.nightclub.01 | stem | jazz pad nightclub warm dark smoky ambient strings c-minor noir late-night atmosphere lush velvet | - | Harvested ambient saw pad recast warm and dark in C minor: detuned voices, opposite-phase filter and pan sweeps, octave-drop bar closing each 8-bar phrase.
pad.jazz.nightclub.02 | stem | jazz pad organ hammond drawbar nightclub smoky soul-jazz warm dark c-minor church vintage mellow | - | vcsl organ_8inch holding dark C minor drawbar chords: slow filter breathing, mask exhale every eighth bar, chords double their pace at peak.
pad.techno.dark_cluster.01 | stem | techno pad cluster phrygian dark dissonant atmosphere drone tension cinematic warehouse brooding | - | Dark warehouse pad built from phrygian b2 clusters: scale-degree chords [0,1,3,4] crawling through a 4-cycle progression, re-triggered 4x per cycle so the saw gain-pump breathes with the kick, vowel morphs, opposite-phase lpf and pan sweeps over 24-32 cycles.
pad.techno.dark_cluster.02 | stem | techno pad fm metallic drone bell inharmonic dark atmosphere industrial gong hypnotic cavern | - | Inharmonic FM flavor of the dark pad: sine carriers with fmh 1.414/3.37 side-band clang, open fifths and phrygian dyads swapping across cycles, long swells in sparse, re-triggered pump in full, mask-gated breathing at peak. Sounds like a resonating boiler room.
pad.trance.wash.01 | stem | trance uplifting pad wash lush vowel pump sidechain warm wide euphoric atmospheric sustained bloom | - | Huge trance wash: smooth voice-led E-major progression (E, C#m, A/E, B/D#) re-triggered quarter-note to ride the isaw pump, drifting vowel formants, a 32-cycle lpf swell with a counter-phase cosine pan, and a big room tail.
pad.trance.wash.02 | stem | trance dream-trance pad glass additive partials airy breath shimmer atmospheric delicate floating bell | - | Glassy sibling built from additive sine partials instead of saws: high bell-like E-major voicings swelling in half-note waves, call-and-response mask breathing across cycles, opposite-phase pan and cosine filter drift. Peak switches to the quarter-note pump idiom with brighter partials.
pad.trap.string_dread.01 | stem | trap drill hip-hop pad strings dread tense dark cinematic suspense minor detuned sustained ominous score | - | Tense detuned-saw string pad in F minor cycling Fm-Db-Bbm-C(V) with a suspended top line that moves at half the harmonic rate, opposite-phase sine/cosine filter sweeps, and a pumping peak.
pad.trap.string_dread.02 | stem | trap drill hip-hop pad strings staccato stabs wavetable tense cinematic herrmann suspense dark minor nervous score | - | Hitchcock-score sibling on the wt_stringbox wavetable: nervous staccato eighth-note string stabs retriggered via struct over the same F minor dread progression, with a low pedal drone breathing underneath.
pad.ukg.smooth.01 | stem | ukg uk garage 2-step pad warm smooth lush sustained b minor sawtooth silky night garage rnb atmospheric soft | - | Warm filtered-saw pad breathing a B minor Bm-G-D-A progression. Sparse floats on long envelopes; full and peak re-trigger against the beat with the sanctioned saw pump, 7th extensions and octave sparkle canon at peak.
pad.vapor.tape_haze.01 | stem | vaporwave vapor mallsoft pad synth-pad detuned supersaw haze hazy tape wow flutter dreamy warm lush ambient lydian lo-fi retro 80s nostalgic atmospheric wet | - | A hazy F-lydian saw pad worn like old tape: two voices where the second drifts on a slow sine detune signal (5-to-det cents) for tape wow/flutter, opposite-phase filter sweeps and a pan breath, a re-triggered pump in the groove and an octave-drop closing every eight-bar phrase. The lydian G-major glow behind everything. Macintosh Plus smog.
pad.vapor.tape_haze.02 | stem | vaporwave vapor mallsoft pad choir vocal vowel formant haze hazy detuned tape wow dreamy warm lush ambient lydian angelic lo-fi retro nostalgic atmospheric | - | A single-voice F-lydian saw pad pushed through a slowly morphing vowel formant filter so it breathes like a wordless choir (aah-ooh-eee), detuned on a slow sine wow signal for tape flutter under a filter breath, re-triggered to pump in the groove with an octave drop each phrase and a vowel pinned to 'iii' at peaks. Angelic mall-fog — a very different haze from the supersaw pad.
perc.afrobeat.congas.01 | stem | afrobeat highlife afro congas conga bongo tom tuned-drum hand-drums percussion interlocking polyrhythm euclid shaker west african organic rolling hypnotic warm groovy | - | Two interlocking hand-drum voices — a low-tom tumba and a mid-tom answer standing in for low/high congas — each on a rotating euclid so the pattern slowly walks, panned on opposite slow sweeps (sine vs cosine) so the interlock moves across the field. Peak adds a high-tom accent and a shaker shimmer.
perc.amapiano.log_rolls.01 | stem | amapiano toms log drum percussion pitched percussion penv rolls euclid rotating reich yanos afro-house south african sa-house tribal hypnotic rolling | - | Synthesized pitched toms - saturated sawtooth through a 24db filter with a penv down-glide - give a mini log-drum roll in the percussion slot. Two euclid(3,8) tom voices (d3 and a2) rotate their onsets in opposite directions over four cycles while their pans breathe on opposite-phase sweeps; peak adds a third high tom in 5,8 with masked fills. Reichian rolling motion, tuned to D.
perc.buildup.fs_snareroll.01 | stem | snare roll riser buildup perc transition tension edm rave techno dnb 909 fill climb | - | A 909 snare roll that ramps gain and opens its filter every cycle - the build/transition tension tool lifted from full_show's Mix It Up riser.
perc.concrete.found.01 | stem | musique-concrete found-sound percussion perc anvil brakedrum metal metallic industrial euclidean rotation interlock junkyard experimental hypnotic clang | - | Reichian found-metal percussion: anvil and brakedrum walking rotating euclids, woodblock ghost 16ths swung late, framedrum body, iter drift and a slow hi-pass brightness sweep. Industrial, hypnotic, clanging.
perc.concrete.found.02 | stem | musique-concrete found-sound percussion perc woodblock clave guiro cabasa wooden scrape polymeter interlock organic experimental ritual dry | - | Dry found-object groove from wooden and scraped bodies: clave and slitdrum interlock in polymeter, guiro scrapes, cabasa ghost shuffle, call-response masking and a slow lpf drift. Clicky, organic, ritual.
perc.disco.congas.01 | stem | congas bongo tambourine percussion latin disco tumbao shaker cowbell salsoul organic polymeter hand-drums 70s groovy | - | Uzu toms pitched up into a conga tumbao that drifts as a 5-sound polymeter against the 8th grid (realigns every 5 cycles), offbeat tambourine with dub delay, ghost shaker 16ths, rotating cowbell. Peak adds a vcsl bongo euclid that walks through 16 positions.
perc.downtempo.mridangam.01 | stem | downtempo trip-hop carnatic mridangam indian hand-drum percussion perc groove euclid polymeter organic world meditative hypnotic tabla-adjacent | - | A South-Indian mridangam groove folded into downtempo: a thom bass-stroke walking euclid positions against an interlocking ki/tha/dhin cell, konnakol-style polymeter drift at peak, gentle dub delay and a slow pan drift. Carnatic hand-drum language as trip-hop percussion.
perc.dubtech.rim_dub.01 | stem | dub techno dub techno perc rim rimshot delay echo space 909 euclid rotation hypnotic cavernous deep minimal basic channel | - | 909 rimshot walking through rotating euclid positions, drenched in the canonical dub delay (.7 send / .375 time / .55 feedback into a big room). The rotation makes the echo lattice slowly reorganize over 4-cycle periods.
perc.dubtech.rim_dub.02 | stem | dub techno dub techno perc rim shuffle swing triplet tambourine 707 delay echo dark sleepy smoky deep minimal | - | 707 rim in a lazy triplet-shuffle double-hit on the offbeats, darker filtered, with a rotating tambourine cell underneath — same dub delay chamber as the sibling but sleepier, more smoke than lattice.
perc.electro.clap_rot.01 | stem | electro clap 808 handclap euclid rotation reich phasing polyrhythm hypnotic clockwork perc percussion drexciya machine-funk rim | - | Reichian 808 clap machine: euclid (5,8) claps whose rotation walks <0 2 4 6> so the accent pattern slowly orbits the bar, counter-rotated RZ-1 rims drifting the opposite way, opposite-phase stereo pans. Hypnotic clockwork percussion.
perc.electro.clap_rot.02 | stem | electro metal brakedrum agogo woodblock industrial hull submarine aquatic dub delay euclid rotation perc percussion clockwork drexciya | - | Submarine-hull percussion: vcsl brakedrum and agogo struck metal on counter-rotating euclid orbits, dub-delayed so every knock echoes down the trench. Sample-index alternation keeps each strike slightly different. Industrial aquatic clockwork.
perc.exp.prepared_piano.01 | stem | prepared-piano piano percussion experimental cage avant-garde coarse bitcrush cluster idm glitch mallet metallic abstract modern-classical clicks-and-cuts kotekan hypnotic textural | - | John-Cage prepared-piano treated as a percussion voice: minor-second and tritone clusters struck in rotating euclid figures, downsampled with coarse for a bolts-on-strings metallic buzz and choked short with cut so every strike is a damped thunk rather than a ringing chord. Two interlocking clusters weave a kotekan grid; the coarse amount morphs cluster to cluster and a slow filter tide breathes underneath.
perc.footwork.ratchets.01 | stem | footwork juke perc toms ratchet roll triplet 808 rolling hypnotic chicago percussion | - | 808 tom rolls that walk around the bar via euclid rotation, pitch-bent with patterned speed and erupting into constant ply(3) triplet ratchets at peak — rolling hypnotic battle percussion.
perc.gamelan.bonang_fm.01 | stem | gamelan javanese bonang fm inharmonic bell metallic imbal interlock kotekan slendro pentatonic hypnotic bright shimmering kettle gong world percussion 2.76 mallet | - | Small kettle-gongs voiced with inharmonic FM at the 2.76 ratio, two players locked in imbal interlock: barung on the on-beats, panerus an octave up on the off-beats, together weaving a continuous 8th-note bonang line in slendro-approx Db major-pentatonic. Sparse is a single mipil call answered every 8 bars in reverse; full runs the two-hand imbal with iter rotation; peak adds a low fmh(1.414) gong anchor and doubles the sparkle.
perc.gamelan.bonang_fm.02 | stem | gamelan javanese bonang panembung fm inharmonic bell metallic mipil gantung slendro pentatonic solemn spacious resonant dark kettle gong world percussion 2.76 | - | The large low bonang panembung: warm inharmonic FM (2.76) bells with long resonant decays playing a slow gantung 'hanging-tone' mipil in Db slendro-approx, one seleh goal-tone per beat alternating across cycles for a real 8-cycle melodic arc. Spacious dub-length delay and a fmh(1.414) sub-gong at peak give it a solemn, cavernous character - the shadow side of the .01 imbal.
perc.gamelan.kotekan.01 | stem | gamelan balinese kotekan handbells interlock polos sangsih 7/8 polymeter odd meter septuple metallic bells hypnotic interlocking cyclic reich world percussion slendro | - | Balinese kotekan interlock cast in a {..}%7 polymeter: polos and sangsih handbell parts fill alternate pulses of a seven-beat cycle so that together they ring one continuous figuration, the whole pattern walking a step each cycle via iter(7) - Reichian rotation over the septuplet grid. Sparse is the polos alone; full adds the octave-up sangsih; peak stacks a third interlocking voice with an octave anchor and reverses every four cycles.
perc.glitch.coarse_ticks.01 | stem | glitch perc percussion clicks-and-cuts ticks coarse crush bitcrush noise crackle idm microhouse pointillist digital minimal dusty oval pole | - | A pointillist tick lattice cut from bitcrushed, downsampled noise over a continuous crushed low brown hum floor: white-noise clicks on a pumped 8th grid, pink euclid ticks with per-step ghost accents, and crackle dust. Coarse sample-rate reduction and crush give every tick a digital burr; a slow hpf sweep and euclid rotation walk the lattice over eight cycles. Oval/Pole grain, perc-slot.
perc.glitch.coarse_ticks.02 | stem | glitch perc percussion metallic granular coarse crush bitcrush resonant noise crackle idm industrial polymeter mechanical clicks-and-cuts digital brittle | - | A metallic, resonant cousin to the coarse tick lattice over a crushed low brown hum floor: crushed noise fired through a sweeping bandpass so each tick rings like struck steel, with three noise colours drifting in polymeter and a chunked speed-doubling transform that walks quarter by quarter. More mechanical and granular than .01's dry clicks — bpq resonance plus coarse aliasing give an industrial burr.
perc.gqom.shaker34.01 | stem | gqom shaker maracas polymeter cross-rhythm 3-vs-4 percussion hats cowbell hypnotic dark sa-club 808 groove | - | 808 maracas in a {3}%4 polymeter that realigns every 3 cycles, riding the pump idiom so on-beat hits duck under the kick. Full adds a Visco hat layer in 5-against-8 with masked breathing; peak throws pitched-up cowbells into the weave with 8-bar double-time fills.
perc.gqom.shaker34.02 | stem | gqom clave woodblock cabasa wood organic polymeter cross-rhythm 3-vs-4 percussion ritual dry clicky sa-club | - | Wooden sibling of the shaker weave: vcsl claves in {3}%4 with subtle per-cycle detune, woodblocks stuttering 5-against-8 underneath, cabasa in 3-over-2 breathing in and out via mask at peak. Dry, clicky, ritualistic — the acoustic answer to the 808 tins.
perc.gqom.tom_rotation.01 | stem | gqom toms percussion euclid rotating reich polyrhythm tribal dark hypnotic sa-club durban visco drums | - | Reichian gqom tom engine: lt and mt play euclid(3,8) cells whose rotation offsets walk in opposite directions over 4 cycles while their pans breathe on opposite-phase sine/cosine sweeps. Peak adds a 5,8 mid layer and masked high-tom fills.
perc.gqom.tom_rotation.02 | stem | gqom darbuka framedrum hand-drum organic percussion euclid rotating world tribal hypnotic agogo sa-club acoustic | - | Organic sibling of the Visco tom engine: vcsl darbuka and framedrum trade euclid cells whose rotations walk opposite directions, sample-index alternation keeps every hit slightly different. Peak sprinkles a masked agogo bell walking its own offsets. Gqom meets hand percussion.
perc.house.shaker_swing.01 | stem | house deep house perc percussion shaker ride tambourine swing shuffle groove hypnotic 16ths club layer | - | 16th shakers swung with a patterned .late grid, pumped by the isaw gain duck, offbeat ride slowly panning, tambourine euclid walking through rotations in the peak. Filter drifts over 32 cycles.
perc.house.shaker_swing.02 | stem | house latin house tribal perc percussion tambourine cowbell toms dub delay polymeter playful organic groove | - | Latin-tinged sibling: triplet-elongation tambourine shuffle, dub-delayed cowbell euclid that rotates, and a polymetric tom conversation (lt/mt/ht cycling over 3-against-8) with degradeBy ghosting. Warmer, more playful than the .01 shaker grid.
perc.idm.click_rotation.01 | stem | idm braindance perc percussion clicks clicky euclid rotation rim cowbell casio rz1 aphex autechre angular minimal generative hypnotic | - | Clicky rimshot cells walking a (5,16) euclid whose rotation steps through <0 3 6 9> so the accent lattice slowly turns Reich-style, layered with a saw-pumped RolandTR707 hat euclid and CasioRZ1 cowbell counter-rhythm. Opposite-phase pan/filter sweeps over 24-32 cycles. Minimal, angular, hypnotic.
perc.idm.click_rotation.02 | stem | idm braindance perc percussion clicks clicky euclid rotation dub delay rim cowbell aphex autechre spacious minimal hypnotic | - | Spacier dub sibling of the click rotation: the (5,16,<0 3 6 9>) rimshot euclid is high-passed and drenched in a dotted delay so each click smears into the next, CasioRZ1 cowbell and RolandTR707 hat euclids weaving under it, filters breathing over 16-32 cycles. Subterranean, echo-laden, minimal.
perc.italo.nrg_toms.01 | stem | perc toms italo hi-nrg disco percussion panned stereo euclid rotation cowbell compurhythm 80s syncopated dancefloor | - | Syncopated CR-1000 toms in Reichian euclid rotation — mid and low toms walk around the bar while opposite-phase pan sweeps swing them across the stereo field; offbeat cowbell and ghost tom gallop at peak.
perc.jazz.smallhits.01 | stem | jazz percussion woodblock clave vibraslap cabasa guiro triangle polymeter reich accents latin acoustic playful | - | Vibraslap, woodblock, clave and friends from vcsl drifting on a polymetric conveyor that realigns every 7-9 cycles; delayed, panned, phrase-end doubles.
perc.latin.clave_bell.01 | stem | perc percussion clave son-clave cowbell campana latin salsa mambo afrocuban cuban cabasa woodblock guiro interlock hand-percussion groovy | - | The heartbeat of salsa: an explicit son clave 3-2 (vcsl clave) whose two bars alternate via angle-brackets, interlocked with a mambo cowbell riding steady eighths with wrist accents. Cabasa 16ths pump and sweep, a woodblock euclid rotates, and a guiro scrape answers at peak.
perc.latin.clave_bell.02 | stem | perc percussion campana cowbell cascara timbale paila clave son-clave latin salsa mambo afrocuban maraca guiro energetic | - | Timbale-forward mambo drive: a busy accented mambo cowbell (campana) rides steady eighths over a syncopated cascara shell ostinato on rimshots, anchored by an explicit son clave in 2-3 orientation. Maracas fill the 16ths, opposite-phase pan and filter sweeps breathe, and a guiro euclid rotates at peak.
perc.latin.guiro_shaker.01 | stem | perc percussion guiro cabasa shaker maraca tumba latin cumbia salsa afrocuban scrape rasca hand-percussion organic groovy sunny | - | vcsl guiro playing the long-short 'rasca' scrape (an elongated down-stroke plus two up-ticks) with its speed alternating cycle to cycle, waveshaped for body, anchored by a soft uzu low-tom tumba pulse and a pumping shaker/cabasa 16th bed. Filters and pans drift on opposite phases; peak rotates a cabasa euclid and fires double-time scrape fills.
perc.rave.crash_wash.01 | stem | crash ride cymbal wash perc rave hardcore breakbeat oldskool sizzle metallic euphoric build energy | - | Rave cymbal ceiling: euclid-rotating ride cells drifting across the bar, long crash washes with alternating pitch, hpf shimmer sweeps and an 8th-note pump wall at peak.
perc.techno.metal_euclid.01 | stem | techno perc percussion cowbell rimshot metallic euclidean rotation polyrhythm industrial hypnotic reich dark | - | Reichian metal percussion: uzu cowbell walking a (5,16) euclid whose rotation steps <0 2 4 6> each cycle, 909 rimshot answering on its own rotating (3,16)/(7,16) grid, swung ghost shakers, dub delay, and a slow stereo pan drift. Every 8th cycle plies double.
perc.techno.metal_euclid.02 | stem | techno perc industrial junkyard anvil brakedrum agogo metallic found-sound clang euclidean rotation dark percussion | - | Found-metal flavor of the euclid-rotation gesture: vcsl brakedrum on the rotating (5,16), anvil clanks answering on their own drifting grid, cabasa ghost 16ths and a 909 rim layer for authority at peak. Industrial scrapyard vs .01's tuned cowbell — darker, heavier, more concrète.
perc.trance.roll16.01 | stem | trance uplifting build riser snare roll 909 percussion tension crescendo rave peak-time fill | - | The trance build machine: 909 snare 8ths that ply up through 16ths toward 32nds while gain and highpass climb over an 8-cycle phrase, doubling to a fast(2) roll on the final bar. Peak adds an iterating tom line.
perc.trap.rim_clicks.01 | stem | trap drill hip-hop perc percussion rim rimshot clicks sparse dub delay shaker cowbell syncopated minimal night | - | Sparse syncopated 808 rimshots in a rotating euclid orbit with dubby delay tails, uzu shaker ghosts thinned by degradeBy, and cowbell answers that fade in after the first phrase.
perc.ukg.skippy_rims.01 | stem | ukg uk garage 2-step garage perc percussion rimshot rim ghost notes shaker cowbell skippy shuffle swing 707 dub | - | 707 rimshot skips with heavy ghost-note dynamics and late-pattern shuffle, shaker eighths panning on a slow sine, cowbell euclid rotating its offset with an 8-bar ply fill. Dub delay owns orbit 2.
perc.ukg.skippy_rims.02 | stem | ukg uk garage 2-step garage perc percussion mridangam tabla indian desi hand drum organic skippy ghost notes world shuffle | - | UK desi-garage flavor: mridangam finger strokes (ta, ki, nam) skipping with ghost gains and late shuffle over a rotating thom bass-stroke euclid; ka ticks pan slowly, gumki slides answer at phrase ends.
perc.vapor.rim_echo.01 | stem | vaporwave vapor mallsoft perc percussion rimshot rim echo delay dub spacious sparse minimal atmospheric lo-fi retro hazy wet reverb dreamy | - | Sparse rimshots thrown into a long half-cycle dub delay, drowned in room: an euclid pattern whose rotation slowly walks around the bar (Reichian drift) while a higher ghosted rim answers, a filter breath and pan sweep evolving underneath and a phrase-end double-time fill. Empty-mall reverberant space.
perc.world.darbuka_malfuf.01 | stem | darbuka doumbek tabla malfuf arabic middle eastern belly dance maqam hand drum world percussion perc dum-tek organic driving desert levantine | - | Middle-Eastern darbuka playing the malfuf 2/4 groove: a low center Dum on the downbeat (speed .62) against crisp rim Teks (speed 1.4) on the off-eighths, soft ka fills, dub delay, a slow filter breath and opposite-phase pan drift. Full adds a rotating ka euclid and a lastOf(4) doumbek roll; peak is a driving 16th-note tek roll with iter rotation.
perc.world.framedrum_daf.01 | stem | daf frame drum framedrum riq bendir persian sufi middle eastern hand drum world percussion perc rim organic trance ceremonial acoustic | - | Persian daf / frame drum with deep center booms (speed set by tune) against bright rim slaps (speed 1.3) — the rim/center contrast is the groove. A jingle-ring ghost roll shimmers on the high subdivisions, a rotating rim euclid, opposite-phase filter and pan breaths, and a lastOf(4) roll fill. Peak drives a 16th jingle roll with iter rotation.
perc.world.framedrum_daf.02 | stem | daf frame drum framedrum zarb tombak persian sufi 6/8 compound meter middle eastern hand drum world percussion perc rim organic lilting ceremonial | - | The frame drum in a lilting 6/8 zarb feel: deep center strokes on the two dotted beats, bright rim answers, a rotating rim euclid over six pulses, opposite-phase filter and pan breaths, and a jingle roll that fills every fourth bar. Peak is a rolling 12-subdivision daf with iter rotation. A genuinely different meter and swing from the 4/4 sibling.
process.reich.bell_rot.01 | stem | reich process minimalism bells handchimes chimes mallet euclid rotation bell interlocking hypnotic shimmering luminous meditative pentatonic contemporary classical music box | - | A C-major-pentatonic bell cell on vcsl handchimes distributed across euclid(5,12), the rotation advancing one step per cycle so the five chimes walk their rhythmic positions through the bar and realign at cycle 12. add(note(<0 7 12 7>)) lifts the whole figure through fifth and octave registers for slow In-C evolution, with an octave off-canon and a light bell delay. Peak densifies to euclid(7,12).
process.reich.bell_rot.02 | stem | reich process minimalism bells glockenspiel chimes mallet euclid rotation bell crystalline hypnotic shimmering bright music box pentatonic mixolydian contemporary classical | - | Crystalline sibling: a wide D11 glockenspiel arpeggio on euclid(7,12) with drifting rotation, register-shifted by add(note(<...>)) each cycle and shadowed an octave down for body under a bright dub delay. Brighter, tinier and more music-box than the warm handchimes .01, in mixolydian for the flat-seven glint.
process.reich.clapping.01 | stem | reich steve reich clapping music phase phasing process minimalism polymeter percussion claves woodblock wooden interlocking hypnotic rhythmic dry contemporary classical 70s | - | Reich Clapping Music read through a precessing polymeter: a fixed 12-pulse clave cell against a woodblock cell in {..}%13 that slips one slot every cycle and realigns after 12 cycles. Peak adds a counter-precessing agogo at %11 for a three-way interference lattice over a soft slitdrum pulse (the drums slot it claims).
process.reich.clapping.02 | stem | reich steve reich clapping music phase phasing process minimalism claps handclaps percussion rotation interlocking hypnotic rhythmic human contemporary classical polymeter body | - | The faithful reading: two identical 808-clap performers on the 12-pulse cell, the second running .iter(12) so it steps exactly one eighth per cycle and cycles through all twelve phase relationships before returning to unison at cycle 12 — same pulse, pure phase. Peak seeds a %13 rim polymeter and a low tom for weight. Drier and more human than the woodblock .01.
process.reich.marimba_add.01 | stem | reich terry riley in c riley process minimalism marimba mallet mallets interlocking cell pattern music hypnotic meditative bright wooden pulse contemporary classical 70s trance-inducing | - | Terry-Riley In-C cell advancement on vcsl marimba: a long <> chain of interlocking C-major cells steps forward one figure per cycle over a ~35s traversal while filter and pan sweep on 48-cycle arcs. An octave-up off-canon and octave-down superimpose fill the lead and pad registers it claims, so one stem is a whole mallet ensemble.
process.reich.marimba_add.02 | stem | reich terry riley in c riley process minimalism vibraphone vibes mallet mallets interlocking cell pattern music hypnotic dreamy nocturnal warm shimmering contemporary classical meditative | - | Nocturnal sibling of the marimba engine: the same In-C cell-advancement process on warm sustained vcsl vibraphone_soft in D mixolydian, with soft dub delay, a lopsided 3/16 octave off-canon and every-8 reversals. Dreamier, slower, glassier than the bright marimba .01.
process.reich.phase_pianos.01 | stem | reich piano phase process minimalism phasing piano keys hypnotic interlocking pattern music steve reich meditative 70s shimmering polyrhythm trance-inducing | - | Two identical 12-note piano cells in D mixolydian, the second running fast(1+1/drift) so it slips one pulse every few cycles and laps the anchor after ~63 cycles — true Reich Piano Phase. Peak adds a third octave-up voice phasing backward for a three-way interference lattice.
process.reich.phase_pianos.02 | stem | reich phasing process minimalism electric piano fmpiano rhodes dx7 nocturnal dreamy hypnotic glassy pattern music ambient night meditative | - | Nocturnal sibling of Piano Phase: a rising-falling 8-note pentatonic-ish cell in C major on vcsl fmpiano (DX-style electric piano), phasing at 1+1/47 with soft dub delay — darker, slower-lapping, glassier than the acoustic .01.
process.reich.pulse_organ.01 | stem | reich four organs process minimalism organ pulse pulsing euclid rotation drone hypnotic sustained meditative church organ harmony contemporary classical glass hieratic | - | Four-Organs-flavored pulsing pad: a C-major seventh chord retriggered on a euclid(5,12) pulse whose rotation drifts one step per cycle, walking the accent through the bar and realigning after 12 cycles. Diatonic I-IV-V-IV planing via add(note(<0 5 7 5>)) and a saw-gain re-trigger pump give the hieratic minimalist swell. Peak thickens to a ninth on euclid(7,12).
process.reich.pulse_organ.02 | stem | reich four organs process minimalism organ pulse augmentation euclid rotation dominant hypnotic sustained grand church organ contemporary classical evolving mixolydian hieratic | - | The augmentation process itself: one held D11 dominant chord (mixolydian, the dominant mode) on vcsl organ_full, pulsed on a drifting euclid grid while its note lengths slowly grow and shrink via a <> sustain envelope — the gradual elongation that is Four Organs. No chord change, only stretching. Peak drops an octave pedal beneath and augments toward near-full sustain.
texture.concrete.tape.01 | stem | musique-concrete plunderphonics tape striate spoken-word speech collage cut-up found-sound experimental avant-garde sound-art hypnotic lo-fi texture acousmatic | - | Plunderphonic tape-splice bed: spoken-word samples striated into varispeed grain across the cycle, reverse flips every 4 cycles, iter-rotated collage and a 32-cycle filter drift. Hazy, hypnotic, cut-up radio.
texture.concrete.tape.02 | stem | musique-concrete plunderphonics tape striate shortwave radio dropout glitch speech spoken-word found-sound experimental avant-garde decayed lo-fi texture noise | - | Damaged-transmission concrete: verbal fragments striated through a hi-passed telephone band with random tape dropouts, sometimes-reversed grains, iter drift and dub delay. Glitchy, decayed, shortwave-radio uncanny.
texture.dnb.breath_fx.01 | stem | dnb drum and bass jungle liquid texture breath fx atmosphere air noise riser sweep transition whisper ethereal organic space | - | An airy transitional atmosphere for jungle & liquid: reversed dirt-samples breaths swelling through a long dub delay, laced with filtered noise risers and white-noise hats. Opposite-phase filter tides and mask gating keep it perpetually shifting; degrade/perlin give every pass its own drift.
texture.downtempo.rain.01 | stem | downtempo trip-hop texture rain crackle noise field-recording ambient atmosphere weather hiss rumble nature immersive grey melancholic | - | A field of rain: crackle raindrops swept under a pink-noise hiss and a distant brown-noise rumble, opposite-phase filter drifts, a masked breakdown and a filtered gust every eighth cycle, white-noise splashes at peak. A living weather bed for downtempo.
texture.downtempo.rain.02 | stem | downtempo trip-hop texture rain drizzle crackle drips noise ambient intimate cozy atmosphere weather window warm melancholic | - | An intimate close-mic drizzle: sparse warm crackle taps with occasional sine water-drips pinging through delay, a soft pink hiss and, at peak, a low brown wind and denser droplet melody. Cozy and melancholic where the rain bed is a wide-open storm.
texture.drone.night_air.01 | stem | noise pink wind air atmosphere texture drone ambient field-recording night bandpass breath wash cinematic unpitched spacious | - | Pink noise re-triggered into a continuous nocturnal wind and drawn through a slowly sweeping band-pass filter — the passband drifts on one clock, a broad pan moves the air ear to ear on another, and the reverb keeps it distant and wide.
texture.drone.psaltery.01 | stem | psaltery bowed zither strings shimmer texture drone ambient ethereal e-major euclid delay glassy celestial spacious cinematic | - | High bowed-psaltery clusters glinting through a rotating euclid pulse, their triads planing between E, A, B and F# majors while a dub delay smears the tails into a shimmering wash and a slow filter and pan keep the air moving.
texture.drone.psaltery.02 | stem | psaltery bowed zither strings phasing reich texture drone ambient minimalism e-major delay liquid crystalline hypnotic shimmer | - | Sibling to the shimmer: two identical bowed-psaltery cells, one a hair faster (fast 64/63), slide out of phase and slowly re-lock every 63 cycles in a Reich interference pattern — a liquid downpour of glass rather than a sparse glint.
texture.dubtech.hiss_field.01 | stem | dub techno techno dub ambient texture noise pink noise hiss crackle vinyl dust tape field atmosphere air deep lofi night | - | Pink-noise room tone drifting on a 16-cycle perlin filter walk, dusted with vinyl crackle and rotating euclid white-noise air ticks — the tape-machine atmosphere a dub techno room breathes in.
texture.electro.sonar.01 | stem | electro sonar ping submarine delay echo texture deep-sea aquatic drexciya sparse ambient sine radar signal lonely | - | Sonar pings in the dark — a bare sine blip repeated into long feedback delay, its euclid placement rotating around the bar while the echoes pan slowly across the trench. Sparse is one lonely ping per cycle with a masked silence every fourth; peak answers with a lower triangle echo an octave down, counter-rotated and counter-panned.
texture.electro.sonar.02 | stem | electro hydrophone knock woodblock clave hull texture polymeter dub delay aquatic deep-sea organic irregular drexciya found-sound | - | What the hydrophone hears: woodblock and clave knocks against the hull, thinned at random like debris drifting past, phasing in a 7-against-8 polymeter that realigns every seventh cycle, every knock dub-delayed into the deep. Peak adds a counter-rotated brakedrum clang. Irregular, organic, never twice the same.
texture.exp.reverse_field.01 | stem | reverse musique-concrete texture experimental granular found-sound break field glitch idm abstract drift atmospheric tape hauntology dusty backwards ambient hypnotic | - | A tumbling backwards field built from chopped-and-reversed found material: a breakbeat is sliced and its grain order flipped so the loop rolls in reverse chunks, layered with a reversed ocean-drum swell. iter() slowly walks the grain sequence and a long filter tide plus perlin panning keep the field drifting in space. Rhythmic enough to lock onto, abstract enough to be pure texture.
texture.exp.reverse_field.02 | stem | reverse musique-concrete texture experimental granular found-sound field drone gong glass metallic ambient abstract backwards cinematic atmospheric dark-ambient hauntology weightless | - | A weightless reversed field grown from struck orchestral-junk one-shots: gongs, a wineglass, framedrum, siren and train-whistle are chopped, grain-reversed and time-stretched into a slow backward wash. No drums, no pulse — just metal and glass tumbling upward, walked by iter() and every-rev, smeared through a big reverb with a slow filter tide. A pure drone-texture bed a crowd can float on.
texture.footwork.stutter.01 | stem | footwork juke texture splice stutter timestretch break grain smear background lo-fi hypnotic | - | Timestretch texture bed: think-break slices spliced to fill their events — whole-cycle pitch-drop smears at sparse, iter-rotated 8th-note stutter chatter at full, 16-slice polymeter grain-storm trading think against riffin at peak.
texture.gamelan.shimmer.01 | stem | gamelan shimmer additive partials marktrees triangles chimes metallic bells bright sparkle texture atmosphere ambient glistening high world shimmering ethereal pentatonic | - | A high metallic shimmer bed: an additive (partials) sine cloud voiced in a Db pentatonic dyad set, re-triggering on the pump idiom so its glow breathes, dusted with marktrees cascades and degrade-thinned triangle glints on euclid rotations. Opposite-phase pan/lpf sweeps keep it drifting; peak adds sleighbells and a denser 16th re-trigger. Non-deterministic sparkle (declared).
texture.gamelan.shimmer.02 | stem | gamelan shimmer additive partials sus cymbal vibraslap metallic drone dark ominous texture atmosphere ambient cavernous low resonant world brooding ethereal pentatonic | - | The shadow shimmer: a lower additive (partials) sine drone in Db pentatonic dyads, re-triggering on the pump idiom under a slower sustained partials pad, with sus_cymbal and vibraslap glints on euclid rotations instead of bright chimes. Opposite-phase filter/pan sweeps and degrade-thinned metal give it an ominous, cavernous drift - the dark twin of the .01 bright shimmer. Non-deterministic (declared).
texture.gaze.shimmer.01 | stem | shoegaze dreampop dream-pop texture shimmer pink-noise noise sparkle sine air hazy ethereal 90s atmosphere gauzy high glittery wash | - | A shimmering haze: a pink-noise bed drifting under opposite-phase filter and pan sweeps, sprinkled with high sine sparkles that twinkle and degrade like light on water. Full and peak thicken the sparkle and add a white-noise glint. An airy top-end wash for dreampop.
texture.glitch.bitcrush_bed.01 | stem | glitch texture bitcrush crush noise bed drone hum digital atmosphere idm ambient lo-fi sweep oval pole brittle grain | - | A continuous crushed noise bed - a deep low brown drone under a bandpass-swept crushed white hiss, the sample-rate-reduced hum of a dying converter. The bpf center breathes over 24 cycles against an opposite-phase stereo drift, a mask opens a dropout every eighth cycle, and the peak variant arranges six cycles of a climbing saw-swept bed into two cycles of a hard crushed washout. Oval/Pole atmosphere, texture-slot.
texture.glitch.vinyl_dirt.01 | stem | glitch texture vinyl crackle dust hiss rumble noise lo-fi surface-noise idm ambient nostalgic warm oval pole lowercase grain | - | The surface noise of a worn record: a continuous low brown-noise rumble is the platter hum, a pink-noise hiss shelf is the groove wear, and a crackle dust layer supplies the pops and clicks — the crackle IS the groove. A slow lpf breathes on the hiss, masks let the whole bed drop out for a bar, and the peak adds bandpassed white pops with a ply fill. Oval/Pole lowercase texture.
texture.gqom.rumble.01 | stem | gqom texture rumble brown-noise noise sub floor dark pressure atmospheric industrial drone sa-club low-end | - | Sub-heavy brown-noise pulse — the gqom room tone. Low-passed rumble swells on the pump idiom while a 32-cycle filter tide opens and closes the floor; mask gating makes it breathe in 4-bar phrases. Peak layers a masked high white-noise wash panning against the rumble.
texture.house.vinyl_bed.01 | stem | texture vinyl crackle dust noise lofi analog warm hiss atmosphere bed ambient house deep house nostalgic | - | Warm record-player bed: crackle dust over a low-passed brown-noise rumble that swells with the bar, pink-noise air panning opposite-phase, mask breathing every 4th cycle. Peak turns the noise into a pumping 8th-note wash with roll fills.
texture.idm.granular_wt.01 | stem | idm braindance texture granular wavetable scanning cloud grains chip atmosphere aphex autechre ambient evolving shimmer generative rising | - | Bright grain cloud built by granular-scanning the wt_vgame wavetable: a slow signal sweeps grain pitch up the C minor scale over 4-16 cycles while the low-pass climbs with it, short clicky envelopes spray across the stereo field with a dub echo. Rising, shimmering, perpetually re-scanning braindance texture.
texture.idm.granular_wt.02 | stem | idm braindance texture granular wavetable scanning dub delay smear atmosphere aphex autechre ambient evolving dark subterranean | - | Darker dub sibling of the granular scan: cosine drives the grain pitch downward through C minor while longer, smeared envelopes drench in a dotted delay so the wt_granular grains bleed into echo tails, with a touch of waveshaping grit. Subterranean and echo-laden where the .01 is a bright rising cloud. 4-16 cycle scans, opposite-phase filter breath.
texture.rave.riser_fm.01 | stem | riser fm sweep texture build tension rave hardcore transition bells shimmer rising staircase generative | - | Generative tension riser: a segmented saw staircase climbs the F minor scale over 8 cycles while the FM index and hpf sweep upward with it, then resets — perpetual build energy, bell-metal timbre from inharmonic fmh.
texture.riser.fs_sweep.01 | stem | riser sweep texture buildup trance edm cinematic ascending sawtooth tension climb fx transition hopeful | - | A sawtooth climbing the C-minor scale over eight cycles with an opening filter and dub delay — the euphoric build sweep from full_show's Crescendo.
texture.riser.fs_sweep.02 | stem | riser whoosh noise texture buildup edm fx transition air white-noise sweep tension drop atmosphere | - | Filtered white/pink noise that opens and swells across the bar — the un-pitched whoosh flavor of the build sweep, for transitions and drops.
texture.techno.white_riser.01 | stem | techno texture riser noise white-noise sweep transition build tension fx whoosh warehouse | - | 8-bar white-noise risers with the arrange seam as the payoff: seven cycles of hpf+lpf+gain climbing on phrase-locked saw ramps, then one cycle of falling-filter washout. Peak compresses the form to four bars with a brown-noise impact. Sparse is a masked airy bed.
texture.trance.white_lift.01 | stem | trance uplifting texture riser lift white-noise noise sweep build tension fx transition wash atmosphere | - | Phrase-length white-noise lifts: gain and highpass climb together over the 8-cycle phrase then reset, with a long pink-noise exhale masked onto the first cycle of each phrase so every drop lands on an impact wash. Peak halves the phrase and adds rhythmic noise ticks.
texture.ukg.hiss.01 | stem | ukg uk garage texture vinyl hiss crackle dust noise lofi lo-fi tape air atmosphere bed warm nostalgic | - | Dusty record-player air: crackle grit under a bandpassed pink-noise hiss that drifts on opposed slow sine sweeps, needle-tick white noise walking a rotating euclid, low brown-noise rumble breathing in and out.
texture.world.ocean_gong.01 | stem | ocean drum oceandrum gong wash waves sea water ambient drone texture world meditative spa cinematic atmosphere field recording ritual spacious | - | A wide ambient wash: the vcsl ocean drum rolls its beads with a slow tidal filter breath and a broad opposite-phase pan sweep, while distant gongs and gong2 strike on the downbeat and alternate at phrase ends, drenched in reverb. A high sped-up wash layer shimmers on top. Peak swells into an ocean storm with a gong gamelan and lastOf fills. Unpitched atmosphere.
vox.afrobeat.call_response.01 | stem | afrobeat highlife afrobeats afro west african vox vocal chant call-and-response call-response speech shout communal syncopated bright uplifting groovy shabda tts percussive | - | Bright afrobeat/highlife call-and-response chant: a syncopated dirt-samples speech backbone (the leader's call, sped up bright) answered by shabda female shout words (sunrise / electric / paradise) as the communal response. Sparse trades one call and answer; full pushes an off-beat 8-slot chant with an octave-echo double and every-4 lift; peak doubles up with jux-reversed calls and a lastOf reverse turnaround. Groove holds if the shabda voice drops out.
vox.amapiano.soft_chant.01 | stem | amapiano vox vocal chant vowel choir wordless hum soft yanos private school afro-house south african sa-house atmospheric soulful minor | - | Wordless amapiano vocal atmosphere: soft sawtooth triads through the vowel formant filter, humming o-u-a across a Dm / C / Bb / Am chant in D minor. Sparse holds slow soft 'ooh's; full re-triggers with a pumped duck and morphing vowels; peak morphs faster and hangs an octave-up echo halo. The hush behind the beat.
vox.ambient.breath_wash.01 | stem | ambient drone ambient techno downtempo cinematic vox vocal breath breathing wash texture stretched reverb serene floating meditative airy human organic | - | Whole breaths saturated and stretched into overlapping reverb washes: a driving per-cycle breath layered over slow half- and quarter-speed breath drones, slow filter and pan drift, periodic reversals. Serene, floating, human. Shaped and gained to stay audible where fragile breath textures vanish.
vox.ambient.granular_voice.01 | stem | ambient drone vox vocal voice speech granular chopped striate grains wash texture blurred drifting atmospheric reverb dreamy plunderphonics hypnagogic meditative | - | Dirt-samples speech shattered into grains by chop and striate, slowed and drowned in room and dub delay into an atmospheric, blurred vocal cloud. Sparse drifts one chopped voice through a slow filter breath; full layers a half-speed reversed striated bed beneath a denser grain stream; peak stacks three chopped/sliced/reversed voices into a wide swirling wash with periodic phrase reversals. A human voice dissolved into weather. Non-pitched, drifting, meditative.
vox.club.chant_m.01 | stem | club bass music garage grime dancehall vox vocal chant hype mc male tts spoken chop chopped selecta commanding soundsystem energetic | - | Male TTS soundsystem calls (selecta / rewind / heavyweight / riddim) chopped in two and doubled up with every-bar chop-4 stutters, opposite-phase filter/pan and drifting speeds. Commanding club/soundsystem energy that keeps grooving if the TTS drops out.
vox.concrete.breath_cuts.01 | stem | musique-concrete vox vocal voice breath slice reverse chops whisper airy intimate found-sound experimental atmosphere human organic | - | Breath sliced and reversed into a living vocal texture: inhale/exhale fragments reordered across the cycle and flipped backward, speechless syllables answering, iter rotation and periodic reversals under long reverb. Airy, intimate, uncanny.
vox.concrete.breath_cuts.02 | stem | musique-concrete vox vocal voice speech diphone slice reverse glitch stutter shard found-sound experimental uncanny fractured plunderphonics | - | Glitched verbal concrete: speechless, diphone and speakspell fragments sliced and reversed with random dropouts and stutters, iter rotation and reverse gating under dub delay. Uncanny, fractured, half-heard speech.
vox.concrete.phoneme_cloud.01 | stem | musique-concrete concrete phoneme cut-up collage alphabet speech spoken-word vox vocal voice cloud texture drumless uncanny experimental avant-garde sound-poetry atmospheric abstract | - | A musique-concrete cloud of cut-up speech: alphabet letters, slurred words and speechless syllables scattered across the stereo field at drifting speeds, unpitched and drumless. Sparse is a thin drift; full swells its letter grid from three hits to a full eight-step cloud over four cycles; peak layers alphabet, reversed speech, speechless splices and ades fragments into a dense uncanny wash under long reverb. Never a beat, only voices condensing and thinning.
vox.disco.soul_chop.01 | stem | disco nu-disco soul funk dance vox vocal diva chop chops diphone vowel pitched filter-sweep four-on-the-floor euphoric glossy uplifting female dancefloor | - | A pitched diphone diva vowel chopped four-on-the-floor across a D-dorian soul progression: glossy filter sweeps and pan in opposite phase, an octave-up off-canon halo, every-4-bar double-time lifts, jux-reversed answers and a lastOf-8 fifth-up climb. Euphoric, glossy, uplifting.
vox.dnb.liquid_vox.01 | stem | dnb drum and bass liquid liquid dnb vox vocal hook diphone vowel pitched rolling soulful uplifting smooth female atmospheric night | - | Soulful sustained diphone vowel hook for liquid drum & bass — a rolling e-dorian melody with vowel-filter morphing, octave off-canon halo, opposite-phase filter and pan sweeps, and every-4-bar double-time rolls. Smooth, uplifting, flowing.
vox.drill.adlib.01 | stem | drill uk drill ny drill trap grime rap vox vocal adlib ad-lib stab stabs dark menacing sinister sparse half-time syncopated unpitched night | - | Dark UK/NY drill ad-libs — pitched-down 'yeah', 'ades' and speech stabs machine-placed off the grid over a slow half-time feel. Sparse drops two menacing stabs per cycle under a low filter breath; full scatters more with a higher speed-up echo canon and every-4 double-time flurries; peak jux-mirrors a denser reversed-and-forward barrage. Unpitched, sparse, sinister — the space between the hits does the threatening.
vox.drone.vowel_choir.01 | stem | drone ambient vox vocal choir voices vowel formant sawtooth sustained pad meditative heavenly breathy cinematic spacious atmospheric slow | - | A drumless synthetic choir: sawtooth triads held through the vowel formant filter, morphing a-e-i-o-u across five-second cycles as a glacial lpf and opposite-phase pan breathe under a cathedral room. Sparse holds two long chords in slow drift; full re-triggers the voicing to keep a steady breathing body with a gentle saw pump; peak thickens the harmony, adds an octave halo and a faster vowel morph. Meditative, heavenly, breathy. Never silent, never static.
vox.dubtech.echo_ghost.01 | stem | dub techno dub techno vox vocal ghost echo delay spoken fragments breath ethereal eerie smoky deep hypnotic night nondeterministic | - | Ghostly vocal fragments — breaths, half-words, pitched diphone syllables and the occasional 'yeah' — surfacing at random through a long dub delay and vanishing again; nondeterministic by design, every pass is a different seance.
vox.exp.alphabet_cutup.01 | stem | cut-up spoken-word vox voice experimental dada sound-poetry alphabet speech phoneme idm abstract glitch collage avant-garde echo hypnotic atmospheric concrete | - | Spoken-alphabet phonemes rearranged into cut-up sound-poetry: letters are dealt out of the dirt-samples alphabet folder in shifting <> stanzas, speed-bent and answered by a reversed echo voice, then walked by iter() with phrase-end reversals. Long delay throws and a slow filter/pan tide turn scattered consonants and vowels into a spacious, Dada-ish recitation.
vox.exp.alphabet_cutup.02 | stem | cut-up spoken-word vox voice experimental glitch sound-poetry alphabet numbers speech idm stutter breakcore collage generative abstract frantic clicks-and-cuts dada | - | A frantic, stuttering cousin of the alphabet poem: each letter is chopped in two and machine-gunned, spliced with spoken numbers and gated by <> call-and-response masks so fragments drop in and out. degradeBy thins the stream generatively and every-rev spits phrases backwards. Short slap delays and perlin panning make it a glitchy, disoriented spelling-bee — abstract but locked to a pulse.
vox.footwork.chop_stutter.01 | stem | footwork juke chicago ghetto house 160bpm dance vox vocal speech chop chops stutter ratchet pitched soul triplet frantic bouncy energetic female dancefloor | - | A pitched chopped-soul speech vocal stuttered on a triplet/16th footwork grid with ratcheting .ply("<1 2 3>") repeats, opposite-phase filter and pan drift, an octave-up off-canon at triplet offset, every-4-bar double-time bursts, jux-reversed answers and a lastOf-8 lift. Frantic, bouncy, Chicago footwork.
vox.gamelan.kecak.01 | stem | gamelan kecak ketjak balinese bali indonesia vox vocal chant monkey chant chatter interlocking polymeter percussive ritual ceremonial trance hypnotic world unpitched | - | Balinese kecak 'chak' — short clipped vocal ticks (ades hits sped and end-gated) woven into interlocking polos/sangsih layers that drift against each other via polymeter. Sparse locks two offset streams into the classic on/off interlock; full stacks a third euclidean accent and rotating {..}%8 groups with double-time bursts; peak micro-shifts a 16th stream with .late, adds a euclidean speech 'leader' call, jux-mirrors and accelerates into ritual trance. Unpitched, hypnotic, ceremonial.
vox.garage.2step_diva.01 | stem | uk garage 2-step garage speed garage deep house dance vox vocal diva hook diphone2 vowel pitched swung soulful sensual uplifting smooth female night dancefloor | - | A soulful pitched diphone2 diva vowel sung as a sustained hook with classic swung 2-step placement (heavier patterned .late lilt, never .swing), filter and pan sweeping in opposite phase, an octave-up off-canon shadow, every-4-bar double-time answers and a lastOf-8 fifth lift. Sensual, uplifting, deep garage.
vox.gaze.wash_vox.01 | stem | shoegaze gaze dreamgaze dream pop dreampop ambient vox vocal wash washed buried reverb wall of sound hazy melancholic dreamy ethereal diphone pitched melodic | - | A pitched diphone vowel smeared into a shoegaze wall — legato notes drowned in big room and long delay so consonants dissolve and only the melody's ghost survives. Sparse floats one slow e-minor line under a deep filter drift; full adds an octave-up halo canon and per-4 reversals with a slow breathing swell; peak jux-mirrors the whole haze and leans a fifth on the phrase turn. Low in the mix, melancholic, but always just barely legible.
vox.gqom.shout_stab.01 | stem | gqom sgija broken-beat taxi-kick south african sa-gqom vox vocal shout stab stabs speech yeah unpitched dark menacing sparse cavernous gritty underground | - | Dark South African gqom vocal shouts (unpitched dirt-samples speech + yeah stabs) pitched way down and thrown into broken 3+3+2 space: one menacing call in sparse, a tresillo shout phrase with a deeper ghost echo and every-4 ply fill in full, and a chopped, jux-reversed doubled barrage at peak. Sparse, cavernous, menacing.
vox.hiphop.ades_cuts.01 | stem | hiphop hip-hop turntablism boom bap scratch dj vox vocal ades cuts speed reverse gritty funky oldschool 90s breaks cutting | - | Turntablist 'ah'/'fresh' vocal cuts scratched with a forward/reverse speed pattern, opposite-phase filter and pan sweeps, chunk-swept reverse flares and an every-4 double-time transform. Gritty boom-bap DJ energy.
vox.hiphop.ades_cuts.02 | stem | hiphop hip-hop turntablism scratch dj glitch vox vocal ades chirp transformer striate stutter speed masked busy technical cutting | - | Striated 'chirp/transformer' style vocal stutters gated by a rotating mask, ply doubles and forward/reverse speed flicks; cosine filter vs sine pan, chunk reversals at peak. Busy, glitchy turntablism.
vox.house.diva_chops.01 | stem | house deep house garage dance vox vocal diva hook diphone vowel pitched chops soulful uplifting euphoric female clubby night | - | A single diphone vowel pitched into a soaring house-diva hook across a b-minor i-VI-VII-v progression; octave off-canon halo, filter and pan sweeps in opposite phase, every-4-bar double-time fills. Deep, soulful, uplifting.
vox.house.diva_chops.02 | stem | house garage 2-step ukg vox vocal diva diphone chops chopped gated hypnotic deep clubby female vowel groove swung | - | Diphone diva syllables chopped in two and rotated through a b-minor line with 2-step call/response masking and iter rotation; hypnotic, gated, deeper and choppier than the open hook. Cosine filter vs sine pan in opposite phase.
vox.idm.granular_glitch.01 | stem | idm braindance glitch autechre aphex granular stutter ratchet chopped speech spoken vox vocal voice bitcrush clicky cerebral intricate electronica | - | Speech and spoken digits shattered into granular braindance: chop() dices each word, ply() ratchets it into stutter bursts, and light crush/coarse bit-dice the grain before shape() reclaims the level. chunk and iter walk the shards while a saw pump ducks the on-beat onsets. Autechre-ish, intricate, restless.
vox.idm.numbers_grid.01 | stem | idm braindance glitch electronica ambient techno vox vocal numbers spoken euclid grid rotation cerebral mechanical hypnotic clicky aphex | - | Spoken-digit vocals gated through a shifting euclid grid that rotates its pulse each cycle, with iter and chunk sweeps and opposite-phase filter/pan motion. Cerebral, mechanical, hypnotic braindance counting.
vox.idm.numbers_grid.02 | stem | idm braindance glitch electronica vox vocal numbers spoken polymeter counting stutter masked ply playful off-kilter clicky glitchy | - | Spoken digits in a 7-against-4 polymeter that slowly realigns, ply-doubled and mask-gated with chunk reversals; drifting speeds pitch the count. Playful, stuttery, off-kilter braindance.
vox.italo.vowel_choir.01 | stem | vox choir vowel aah voices formant italo hi-nrg disco euphoric heavenly lush 80s retro synthetic | - | Synthetic 'aah' choir: saw triads through the vowel formant filter, morphing a-o-e across a I-vi-IV-V progression in A major; pumped 4x re-triggers in full, octave off-echo halo and faster vowel morph at peak.
vox.jazz.breath_scat.01 | stem | jazz vox vocal breath scat texture airy human whisper organic late-night intimate atmosphere voice | - | Harvested reversed-breath transitions grown into a living texture: pitched-down breath swells with degrading baa scat accents drifting across the stereo field.
vox.jazz.breath_scat.02 | stem | jazz vox vocal scat diphone syllables bebop swing babble playful human voice phonetic quirky | - | Pitched diphone syllables swung into scat phrases: elongation-pair shuffle, mask call-and-response, iter rotation and random speed warble at peak.
vox.jungle.ragga_chop.01 | stem | jungle ragga jungle ragga breakbeat vox vocal chops stabs speech yeah dark aggressive sparse unpitched dub night underground | - | Dark, sparse, aggressive ragga jungle vocal stabs — chopped yeah/speech/ades2 samples pitch-dropped with speed alternation, off-canon echoes, jux(rev) in the peak. Mostly unpitched; sparse phrases in a half-time feel against fast drums.
vox.pop.chant_f.01 | stem | pop synthpop dance-pop electropop dream-pop vox vocal chant hook female tts spoken pitched dreamy catchy uplifting bright anthemic | - | Female TTS words pitched by a rising speed contour into a bright pop hook, with an octave off-echo halo, opposite-phase filter/pan sweeps and every-4 double-time lifts. A pitched diphone counter-chant keeps the hook audible even while the TTS pack warms. Dreamy, catchy, uplifting. Groove survives if the TTS layer drops out.
vox.rave.yeah_stabs.01 | stem | rave hardcore breakbeat oldschool hoover vox vocal yeah stab stabs ply pump hype energetic euphoric 90s anthem dancefloor | - | Classic 'yeah' vocal stabs machine-gunned with ply doubles and a saw gain pump; alternating sample picks and speeds, opposite-phase filter/pan sweeps and an every-4 ply-2 fill. Euphoric oldschool rave energy.
vox.rave.yeah_stabs.02 | stem | rave jungle hardcore breakbeat darkcore vox vocal yeah chop chopped reverse euclid ply frantic ruff dark hype 90s | - | Darker jungle-flavoured 'yeah' hits chopped and sometimes reversed, walking through euclid rotation and drifting speeds; every pass mutates. Frantic, ruff, nondeterministic.
vox.reggaeton.chant.01 | stem | vox vocal chant hype shout mc reggaeton dembow latin urban perreo tts pitched-down dub-delay male-voice club | - | Male TTS hype-man shouts (shabda-vox-m) pitched down and thrown into a dotted dub delay: single-word calls in sparse, a tresillo-placed 3+3+2 chant phrase in full pumped by the isaw duck, and a chopped stutter with fills at peak. A garnish layer - stays musical if the external voice drops out.
vox.techno.speech_filter.01 | stem | techno dub techno minimal tech house vox vocal speechless vowel formant loop morph hypnotic driving deep warehouse peak time robotic | - | A wordless vocal loop chopped and morphed through a slowly cycling vowel formant filter, opposite-phase lpf and pan sweeps, chunk reversals at peak. Hypnotic driving techno vocal texture.
vox.techno.speech_filter.02 | stem | techno dub techno dub deep techno vox vocal speechless vowel slice stabs dubby cavernous deep subterranean masked echo hypnotic smoky | - | Sliced wordless vocal stabs answering across a rotating slice order and vowel morph, call/response mask and iter rotation under cavernous dub reverb and delay. Deep, dubby, subterranean techno.
vox.trance.anthem_hook.01 | stem | trance uplifting trance anthem vox vocal hook diphone vowel pitched ethereal euphoric uplifting female wide big room hands up night | - | Ethereal uplifting female anthem hook — a pitched a-major diphone vowel backbone with a big-room halo, half-cycle delay, opposite-phase filter and pan sweeps and an octave off-canon, lifted by a lone shabda-vox-f word ("higher") once per phrase. Euphoric, wide, hands-up.
vox.triphop.smoky_vox.01 | stem | trip-hop downtempo smoky sultry vox vocal voice diphone pitched dusty rainy nocturnal intimate moody noir portishead massive-attack bluesy sensual night | - | A pitched diphone vowel sung as a low, sultry trip-hop phrase over a d-dorian line — dark filter, warm shape and a dusty micro-detune keep it smoky. Sparse breathes one bluesy figure per cycle; full answers itself with an octave-up off() canon and a phrase-end lift; peak chops and jux-reverses the line into a rainy, drenched double under long dub delay. Nocturnal, intimate, downtempo.
vox.ukg.todd_chops.01 | stem | ukg uk garage garage 2-step speed garage house dance vox vocal todd edwards chop chops confetti diphone vowel pitched micro-slice swung euphoric soulful bright female dancefloor | - | Tiny pitched diphone micro-slices sprayed as syncopated vocal confetti in the Todd Edwards UK-garage tradition: a swung 16th shuffle (patterned .late, never .swing), opposite-phase filter and pan sweeps, octave and fifth off-canon grains stacked into a euphoric wash, every-4-bar double-time flurries and a lastOf-8 lift. Bright, soulful, euphoric.
vox.vapor.speech_slow.01 | stem | vaporwave vapor mallsoft vox vocal voice speech spoken-word slowed half-speed chopped reverb wet drowned dreamy hazy plunderphonics hypnagogic lo-fi retro nostalgic atmospheric sample | - | Half-speed dirt-samples speech drowned in room and a long dub delay — the classic vaporwave slowed vocal drift. Sparse rotates one slurred word per cycle through the sample bank under a filter breath; full trades two words a bar panning slowly; peak chops and ply-stutters a dense drenched wash with a phrase-end fill. A voice remembered underwater.
vox.world.sindhen.01 | stem | sindhen gamelan javanese indonesian world vox vocal voice diphone pitched melisma melismatic ornament bend pentatonic expressive ceremonial meditative floating asian | - | A Javanese sindhen-style pitched vocal: a pitchable diphone tracing melismatic pentatonic phrases with quick ornamental turns and grace-note bends over a Db major pentatonic. Sparse breathes one spacious descending melisma per phrase; full ornaments densely with a semitone grace-echo and a saw pump; peak cascades three-note turns, an octave shimmer halo and a phrase-end bend down. Expressive, ceremonial, floating. scale-sub transposable.
